a: Halacha berura umishna berura bimkom echad.

Tanya, rabbi yose ben elisha omer: im raita dor shetztzarot rabbot baot alav — tze uvedok bedayyayne yisrael. shekkol pureanut shebbaa leolam lo baa ella bishvil dayyayne yisrael, shenneemar: "shimu na zot rashe bet yaakov uketzine bet yisrael hametaavim mishpat veet kol hayeshara yeakkeshu. bone tziyyon bedamim virushalaym beavla. rasheha beshochad yishpotu vechohaneha bimchir yoru unevieha bechesef yiksomu veal Adonai yishshaenu vegomer".

Reshaim hen, ella shettalu bitchonam bemi sheamar vehaya haolam. lefichach, mevi hakkadosh baruch hu alehen shalosh pureaniyyot keneged shalosh averot shebbeyadam, shenneemar: "lachen biglalchem tziyyon sade techaresh virushalaym iyyin tihye vehar habbayit levamot yaar".

Veen hakkadosh baruch hu mashre shechinato al yisrael ad sheyyichlu shoftim veshotrim raim miyyisrael, shenneemar: "veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich veasira kol bedilayich. veashiva shoftayich kevarishona veyoatzayich kevattechilla vegomer".
Amar ulla: en yerushalayim nifdet ella bitzdaka, shenneemar: "tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka".
Amar rav pappa: i batli yehire — batli amgushe. i batli dayyayne — batli gezirpate.
I batli yehire batli amgushe — dichtiv: "veetzrof kabbor sigayich".
I batli dayyayne batli gezirpate — dichtiv: "hesir Adonai mishpatayich pinna oyvech".

Amar rabbi mallay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: may dichtiv "shavar Adonai matte reshaim shevet moshlim". "shavar Adonai matte reshaim" — ellu haddayyaynin shennaasu makkel lechazzanehem. "shevet moshlim" — ellu talmide chachamim shebbemishpechot haddayyaynin. mar zutera amar: ellu talmide chachamim shemlammedim hilchot tzibbur ledayyayne bur.
Amar rabbi eliezer ben mallay mishshum resh lakish: may dichtiv "ki chappechem negoalu vaddam veetzbeotechem beavon, siftotechem dibberu sheker leshonchem avla tehge".

"Ki chappechem negoalu vaddam" — ellu haddayyaynin. "veetzbeotechem beavon" — ellu sofre haddayyaynin. "siftotechem devaro sheker" — ellu orche haddayyaynin. "leshonchem avla tehge" — ellu baali dinin.
Veamar rabbi mallay mishshum rabbi yitzchak magdelaa: miyyom shepperash yosef meechav lo taam taam yayin, dichtiv: "ulekodkod nezir echav".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: af hen lo taamu taam yayin, dichtiv: "vayyishtu vayyishkeru immo", mikkelal dead haiddana la hava shichrut. veiddach, shichrut hu dela hava, shetiyyah miha hava.
Vaamar rabbi mallay: bischar "veraacha vesamach belibbo", zacha lechoshen hammishpat al libbo.
Shelachu leh bene bashkar lelevi: killa mahu? keshuta becharma mahu? met beyom tov mahu?
Addeazel nach nafsheh delevi. amar shemuel lerav menashsheya: i chakkimat, shelach lehu. shelach lehu: killa — chazarnu al kol tzidde killa velo matzinu lah tzad hetter.
Velishlach lehu kidrame bar yechezkel! lefi sheenan bene tora.

Keshuta becharma — irbuva. velishlach lehu kidrabbi tarfon? detanya: keshut, rabbi tarfon omer: en kilayim bakkerem. vachachamim omrim: kilayim bakkerem. vekayyma lan: kol hammekel baaretz, halacha kemoto bechutz laaretz! lefi sheenan bene tora.
Machriz rav: hay man devae lemizra keshuta becharma — lizra. rav amram chasida menagged illaveh.
Rav mesharsheya yahev leh peruta letinok goy vezara leh. velitten leh letinok yisrael! ate lemisrach: velitten leh legadol goy! ate leichallofe beyisrael.
Met — shelach lehu: met lo yitasseku bo lo yehudain velo armain, lo beyom tov rishon velo beyom tov sheni.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yehuda bar shilat amar rabbi assi: ovada hava beve chenishta demaon beyom tov hassamuch lashshabbat,
b: Vela yadana i millefaneha i milleachareha, vaato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, vaamar lehu: yitassekun beh ammin.
Veamar rava: met beyom tov rishon yitasseku bo ammin, beyom tov sheni — yitasseku bo yisrael, vaafillu beyom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana. ma sheen ken bevetza. lefi sheenan bene tora.
Amar rabbi avin bar rav huna amar rav chama bar gureya: mitattef adam bechilla uvechiskaseha veyotze lirshut harabbim beshabbat, veeno choshesh.

May shena midderav huna, deamar rav huna amar rav: hayyotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilchatah beshabbat — chayyayv chattat! tzitzit legabbe tallit — chashivi, vela batli. hane la chashivi, uvatli.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: maarim adam al hameshammeret beyom tov litlot bah rimmonim, vetole bah shemarim. amar rav ashe: vehu detala bah rimmonim.

May shena meha detanya: metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed, shello letzorech hammoed — asur, echad shechar temarim veechad shechar seorim. af al pi sheyyesh lahen yashan — maarim veshote min hechadash!
Hatam la mochcha milleta, hacha mochcha milleta.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe: chazi mar hay tzureba merabbanan verav huna ben rabbi chiyyon shemeh, veamri la rav huna berabbi chilvon shemeh, deshakel bera detuma umannach bevarza dedanna, veamar: leatztzenoeh kamikkavena. veazel venaem bemabbara, veavar lehach gisa vesayayr pire, veamar: ana lemenam kamikkavena!
Amar lehu: haarama kaamrat? haarama bidrabbanan hi, vetzureba merabbanan la ate lemibad lechattechilla.
Mishna notnin mayim al gabbe hashshemarim bishvil sheyyitztzollu. umesannenin et hayyayin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit.
Venotnin betza bimsannenet shel chardal, veosin enomelin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: bashshabbat bechos, beyom tov — belagin, uvammoed — bechavit. rabbi tzadok omer hakkol lefi haorchin.
Gemara amar zeeri: noten adam yayin tzalul umayim tzelulin letoch hameshammeret beshabbat veeno choshesh, aval achurin — la.
Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: tored adam chavit shel yayin yenah ushemareha, venoten letoch hameshammeret bashshabbat veeno choshesh! targema zeeri: ben haggittot shanu.
Mesannenin et hayyayin besudarin. amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: uvilvad shello yaase gumma.
Uvichfifa mitzrit. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: uvilvad shello yagbiah mikkarkaito shel keli tefach.
Amar rav: hay peronka, appalgeh dechubba — shere, akkulleh kubba — asir.
Amar rav pappa: la nihaddak inish tzinyayta befummeh dechuzanta (dechavita), mishshum demechze kimshammeret.
Deve rav pappa shafu shichra mimmana lemana. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: haikka nitzotzot! nitzotzot leve rav pappa la chashivi.
Venotnin betza bimsannenet. tane yaakov karcha:

a: Lefi sheen osin otah ella legavevn.
Ittemar. chardal shellasho meerev shabbat, lemachar, amar rav: memacho bichli aval lo bayyad.
Amar leh shemuel: (bayyad?!) attu kol yoma beyad memachu leh?! maachal chamorim hu! ella amar shemuel: memacho bayyad veeno memacho bichli.
Ittemar. rabbi elazar amar: echad ze veechad ze — asur. verabbi yochanan amar: echad ze veechad ze — muttar. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: en halacha kerabbi yochanan.
Kam rabbi yochanan beshitteh derabbi elazar, kam rabbi elazar beshitteh dishmuel. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: halacha kerabbi yochanan.

Immeh deabbaye avada leh, vela achal. devethu dizira avada leh lerav chiyyay bar ashe, vela achal. amara leh: lerabbach avadi leh vaachal, veat la achlat? amar rava bar sheva: hava kaemna kammeh deravina uvechashi leh beshufeta detuma vaachal.
Amar mar zutera: let hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha deittemar: chardal shellasho meerev shabbat, lemachar memacho ben bayyad ben bichli venoten letocho devash. velo yitrof, ella mearev.

Shachalayim sheshshechakan meerev shabbat, lemachar noten letochan shemen vachometz, umamshich letochan ammita. velo yitrof ella mearev. shum sherisseko meerev shabbat, lemachar noten letocho pol ugerisin, velo yishchok ella mearev, umamshich et ammita letochan. may ammita? ninyay. amar abbaye: shema minna hay ninyay mealleya letachle.

Veosin enomelin beshabbat. tanu rabbanan: osin enomelin beshabbat, veen osin alunetit. veezo hi enomelin veezo hi alunetit? enomelin yayin udevash ufilpelin. alunetit yayin yashan umayim tzelulin vaafarsemon, deavdi leve massuta lemekar.

Amar rav yosef: zimna chada allit batar mar ukeva leve vane. ki nefaki, atay ashkeyayn chamra chad kasa, vechashshi mibbinta dereshi vead tufera dechari. vei ashkeyayn kasa acharina — havay mistefena dilma menakku li mizzachvata dealma deate. veha mar ukeva deshate kol yoma? shane mar ukeva dedash beh.
Mishna en shorin et hachiltit befoshrin, aval noten letoch hachometz. veen sholin et hakkarshinin velo shafin otan, aval noten letoch hakkevara o letoch hakkalkala.
En kovrin et hatteven bichvara, velo yittenennu al gabbe makom gavoah bishvil sheyyered hammotz. aval notel hu bakkevara venoten letoch haevus.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: shara, may? targema rav adda narshaa kammeh derav yosef: shara — chayyayv chattat.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta shera umetza bemayya hachi name demichayyayv? ella amar abbaye: midderabbanan — shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol.
Bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay: mahu lishrot et hachiltit betzonen? amar leh: asur. veha anan tenan: en shorin et hachiltit befoshrin — ha betzonen muttar!
Amar leh: im ken ma ben li velach. matnitin yechidaa hi, detanya: en shorin et hachiltit lo bechammin velo betzonen. rabbi yose omer: bechammin — asur, betzonen — muttar.

Lemay avdi leh? leyukera delibba. rav acha bar yosef chash beyukera delibba. ata lekammeh demar ukeva. amar leh: zil sheti telata tikle chiltita bitlata yome. azal ishti chamsha beshabbeta umaale shabbeta. letzafra azal sheal be midresha. amaru leh: tana deve rav adda, veamri la tana deve mar bar rav adda: shote adam kav o kabbayim veeno choshesh.

Amar lehu: lishtot — la kamibbaya li, ki ka mibbaya li — lishrot, may? amar lehu rav chiyyay bar avin: bedidi hava ovada, vaatay sheelteh lerav adda bar ahava vela hava bideh. atay sheelteh lerav huna, vaamar: hachi kaamar rav, shore betzonen umanniach bachamma.
Keman deshare? afillu leman deasar — hane mille hecha dela ishti kelal, aval hacha — kevan deishti chamsha umaale shabbeta, i la shate beshabbat — mistakkan.

Mistemich veazel rav acha bar yosef akkatpeh derav nachman bar yitzchak bar achateh. amar leh: ki matenan leve rav safra ayyeylinnan. ki meto ayyeyleh. bea minneh: mahu lechaskose kittanita beshabbeta? lerakkoche kittanita ka mikkavven — veshappir dame, o dilma leolode chivvara kamikkavven — vaasir? amar leh: lerakkoche ka mikkavven veshappir dame.
Ki nefak ata, amar leh: may bea mar minneh? amar leh beay minneh: mahu lechaskose kittanita beshabbeta, vaamar li: shappir dame.
Vetibbee leh lemar sudara? sudara la ka mibbaya li, divay merav huna ufeshat li.
Vetippeshit leh lemar missudara? amar leh: hatam — michze ki olode chivvara, hacha — la michze keolode chivvara.
Amar rav chisda: hay kittanita
b: Mishlefa ledida mikkanya — shere, kanya minna — asir. amar rava: veim keli kivvae hu — muttar.
Amar rav chisda: hay kishta deyarka, i chazya lemaachal behema — shere letaltola, vei la — asir.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hay talya, devisra — shere letaltole, dechavvre — asir.
Amar rav kattina: haomed baemtza hammitta, keillu omed bichresah shel ishsha. velav milleta hi.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven yarka — lizben aricha, kishsha ki chishsha, veureka mimmela.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven kanya — lizben aricha, tuna ki tuna, veureka mimmela.

Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav [dela nefisha leh rifta] — la lechol yarka, mishshum degarer. veamar rav chisda: ana la baaniyyuti achali yarka, vela beattiruti achali yarka. baaniyyuti — mishshum degarer. beattiruti — deamena: hecha deayel yarka, leul bisra vechavvre.

Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta — la livtza batztzoe. (veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dela nefisha leh rifta — la livtza. may tama? — dela aved beayin yafa.) veamar rav chisda: ana meikkara la havay batzana ad dishday yadi bechulle mana, veashkachi [beh kol tzurki].

Veamar rav chisda: hay man deefshar leh lemechal nahama disare veachal dechitte kaavar mishshum "bal tashchit". veamar rav pappa: hay man deefshar lemishte shichra veshate chamra — over mishshum "bal tashchit". velav milleta hi — "bal tashchit" degufa adif.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav delet leh mishcha — nimshe bemayya dacharitzi.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven umetza — lizben uneka, deit beh telata mine visra.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav dezaven kittonita — lizban middinhar abba, venichavvevra kol telatin yomin, dimfatteya leh teresar yarche shatta, vaana arva. may "kittonita"? — kitta naa.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav la littiv atztzippeta chadta, dimchalleya maneh.
Veamar rav chisda: bar be rav la lishaddar maneh leushepizeh lechauoreh leh, delav orach ara, dilma chaze beh midde veate lemigganneya.
Amar lehu rav chisda livnateh: tihveyayn tzenian beappe gavrayychu, la techlun nahama beappe gavrayychu.
La techlun yarka belelya, la techlun tamre belelya, vela tishton shichra belelya, vela tippenon hecha demippenu gavrayychu.
Vechi ka kare inish abbava — la temrun "mannu", ella "manni".
Naket marganita bachada yedeh vechura bachada yedeh. marganita — achvi lehu, vechura — la achvi lehu ad demitztaaran, vahadar achvi lehu.
En sholin et hakkarshinin. matnitin dela chi hay tanna, detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: en mashgichin bakkevara kol ikkar.
Mishna gorfin millifne happattam umesallekin litzdadin mippene hari, divre rabbi dosa, vachachamim osrin. notlin millifne behema zo venotnin lifne behema zo beshabbat.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbanan aresha peligi, o assefa peligi, o attarvayyhu peligi?
Ta shema, detanya: vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze — lo yesallekennu litzdadin.

Amar rav chisda: machaloket beevus shel karka, aval beevus shel keli — divre hakkol muttar. veevus shel karka mi ikka leman deshare?! ha ka mashve gummot! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav chisda machaloket beevus shel keli, aval beevus shel karka — divre hakkol asur.
Venotlin millifne behema. tena chada: notlin millifne behema sheppiha yafe venotnin lifne behema sheppiha ra. vetanya iddach: notlin millifne behema sheppiha ra venotnin lifne behema sheppiha yafe!

Amar abbaye: idde veidde mikkamme chamra lekamme tora — shaklinan, mikkamme tora lekamme chamra — la shaklinan. veha dekatane "notel millifne behema sheppiha yafe" — bachamor, delet leh rire. "venotnin lifne behema sheppiha ra" — befara,

a: Deit la rire.
Veha dekatane "notlin millifne behema sheppiha ra" — bachamor, dela dayek veachel. "venotnin lifne behema sheppiha yafe" — befara, dedayyka veachla.
Mishna hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta — lo yenaneennu beyado, ella menaano begufo. veim haya maachal behema, o shehaya alav kar o sadin — menaano beyado.
Machbesh shel baale vattim — mattirin, aval lo kovshin. veshel kovsin — lo yigga bo. rabbi yehuda omer: im haya muttar meerev shabbat — mattir et kullo veshomto.
Gemara amar rav nachman: hay pugela, millemala lematta — shere. millematta lemala — asir.

Amar rav adda bar abba, amri be rav: tenena dela kerav nachman. hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta — lo yenaanennu beyado, aval menaano begufo. veim haya maachal behema, o shehaya alav kar o sadin — menaano beyado. shema minna tiltul min hatztzad — la shemeh tiltul. shema minna.
Amar rav yehuda: hane pilpele, medak chada chada bekatta desakkina — shere, tarte — asir. rava amar: kevan dimshanne — afillu tuva name.
Amar rav yehuda: man desache bemayya — linaggev nafsheh beresha vahadar lislek, dilma ate leetoye arba ammot becharmelit.
I hachi, ki ka nachet name, ka dache kocho arba ammot, vaasir! kocho becharmelit — la gezaru.
Amar abbaye, veittema rav yehuda: tit sheal gabbe raglo — mekannecho bakkarka, veen mekannecho bakkotel.
Amar rava: may tama bakkotel la, mishshum demechze kevone? ha binyan chaklaa hu!
Ella amar rava: mekannecho bakkotel veen mekannecho bakkarka — dilma ate leashvoye gummot.
Ittemar. mar bereh deravina amar: echad ze veechad ze — asur. rav pappa amar: echad ze veechad ze — muttar.
Lemar bereh deravina bemay mekannechi leh? mekannechi leh bekora.
Amar rava: la littiv inish appummeh delichyay, dilma miggandera leh chefetz veate leetoye.
Veamar rava: la litzadded inish kubba, dilma ate leashvoye gummot.
Veamar rava: la lihaddek inish udera befumma deshisha, dilma ate lide sechita.
Amar rav kahana: tit sheal gabbe bigdo — mechaskeso mibbifnim veen mechaskeso mibbachutz.
Metivi: tit sheal gabbe minalo — megarro begav sakkin, vesheal bigdo — megarro betzipporen, uvilvad shello yechaskes. may lav, shello yechaskes kelal! la shello yechaskes mibbachutz, ella mibbifnim.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi yannay: megarrin minal chadash, aval lo yashan.
b: Bamme megarro? amar rabbi avahu: begav sakkin.

Amar leh hahu sava: semi didach mikkamme ha detane rabbi chiyyay: en megarrin lo minal chadash velo minal yashan, velo yasuch et raglo shemen vehu betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal. aval sach et raglo shemen, umanniach betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal. vesach kol gufo shemen, umitaggel al gabbe katvulya, veeno choshesh.
Amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella letzachtzecho, aval leabbedo — asur.
Leabbedo, peshita? vetu: letzachtzecho, mi ikka man deshare?
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav chisda, lo shanu ella shiur letzachtzecho, aval shiur leabbedo — asur.
Tanu rabbanan: lo yetze katan beminal gadol, aval yotze hu bechaluk gadol.
Velo tetze ishsha beminal meruppat, velo tachalotz bo, veim chaltza — chalitzatah keshera.
Veen yotzin beminal chadash. beeze minal amru — beminal shel ishsha.
Tane bar kappara: lo shanu ella shello yatza bo shaa achat mibbeod yom, aval yatza bo meerev shabbat — muttar.
Tane chada: shomtin minal meal gabbe emus, vetanya iddach: en shomtin. la kashya: ha — rabbi eliezer, ha — rabbanan.
Ditnan: minal sheal gabbe emus, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim.
Hanicha lerava, deamar: davar shemmelachto leissur, ben letzorech gufo, ben letzorech mekomo — muttar, shappir.
Ella leabbaye, deamar: letzorech gufo — muttar, letzorech mekomo — asur. may ikka lememar?
Hacha bemay askinan — berafuy. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: im haya rafuy — muttar.
Tama derafuy, ha lo rafuy — la. hanicha leabbaye, deamar: davar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo — muttar, letzorech mekomo — asur, shappir.
Ella lerava, deamar: ben letzorech gufo, ben letzorech mekomo — muttar, may irya rafuy? afillu lo rafuy name!
Derabbi yehuda mishshum derabbi eliezer hu. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: im haya rafuy — muttar.
Haderan alach tolin
Mishna notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado. vechalkalla vehaeven betochah. umetaltelin teruma temea im hattehora, veim hachullin.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af maalin et hamedumma beechad umea.
Gemara amar rava: hotzi tinok chay vechis taluy betzavvaro — chayyayv mishshum kis. tinok met vechis taluy lo betzavvaro — patur.
Tinok chay vechis taluy lo betzavvaro — chayyayv mishshum kis: velichayyayv name mishshum tinok!
Rava kerabbi natan sevira leh, deamar chay nose et atzmo.
Velivtal kis legabbe tinok, mi la tenan et hachay bammitta — patur af al hammitta, shehammitta tefela lo?
Mitta legabbe chay — mevatteli leh, kis legabbe tinok — la mevatteli leh.
Tinok met vechis taluy lo betzavvaro — patur: velichayyayv mishshum tinok! rava kerabbi shimon sevira leh deamar: kol melacha sheen tzarich legufah — patur aleha.
Tenan: notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado? amri deve rabbi yannay betinok sheyyesh lo gaaguin al aviv.
I hachi,

a: May irya even, afillu dinar name! allema amar rava: lo shanu ella even, aval dinar — asur! even, i nafla (la) — la ate avu leetoye. dinar, i nafel — ate avu leetoye.
Tanya kevoteh derava: hammotzi kelav mekuppalim umunnachim al ketefo, vesandalav vetabbeotav beyado — chayyayv. veim haya melubbash bahen — patur.
Hammotzi adam vechelav alav, vesandalav beraglav, vetabbeotav beyadav — patur, veillu hotzian kemot shehen — chayyayv.

Kalkalla vehaeven betochah. veammay? tehve kalkala basis ledavar haasur! amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hacha bechalkalla melea perot askinan. velishdinhu lefere, venishde leeven, veninketinhu beyadayim! kidrabbi ilay amar rav: beferot hammittannefin, hacha name: beferot hammittannefin.
Velinaarinhu naore! amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rava: hacha bechalkalla pechuta askinan, deeven gufah naaset dofen lakkalkalla.
Metaltelin teruma vechulei. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shettehora lematta utemea lemala. aval tehora lemala utemea lematta — shakel leh lithora veshavek leh litmea.
Vechi tehora lematta name, lishdinhu velinketinhu! amar rabbi ilay amar rav: beferot hammittannefin askinan.
Metivi: metaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin, ben shettehora lemala utemea lematta, ben shettemea lemala utehora lematta, teyuveta derav chisda!
Amar lecha rav chisda: matnitin — letzorech gufo, barayyta — letzorech mekomo.
May duchekeh derav chisda leokome matnitin letzorech gufo?

Amar rava: matnitin kevoteh dayyka, dekatane sefa: maot sheal hakkar — menaer et hakkar vehen noflot. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella letzorech gufo, aval letzorech mekomo — metaltelo veodan alav. umiddesefa letzorech gufo — resha name letzorech gufo.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af maalin vechulei. veammay?! ha ka metakken!
Rabbi yehuda kerabbi eliezer sevira leh, deamar: teruma beena machata.
Ditnan: sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea, venidmeu, venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer: medammaat kitrumat vadday.
Vachachamim omrim: en hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon.
Emar deshamat leh lechumera, lekulla mi shamat leh?!
Ella: hu deamar kerabbi shimon, keditnan: sea teruma shennafla lemea, velo hispik lehagebiah ad shennafla acheret — hare zo asura. verabbi shimon mattir.

Umimmay? dilma hatam beha kamippalgi, detanna kamma savar af al gav denaflu baze achar ze — keman denafal bevat achat dame. veha lechamshin nefala, veha lechamshin nefala. verabbi shimon savar: kammayyta betil bima, veha tivtel bima vechad.
Ella: hu deamar kerabbi shimon ben elazar. detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: noten enav betzad ze, veochel mitztzad acher.
Umi savar leh kevoteh?
b: Veha miflag pelig illaveh, detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: maalin et hamedumma beechad umea. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: noten enav betzad ze veochel mitztzad acher.
Derabbi yehuda adifa midderabbi shimon ben elazar.
Mishna haeven sheal pi hechavit — mattah al tziddah, vehi nofelet. hayta ben hechaviyyot — magbihah umattah al tziddah, vehi nofelet.
Maot sheal hakkar — menaer et hakkar, vehen noflot. hayta alav lishleshet — mekannechah bismartut. hayta shel or — notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle.
Gemara amar rav huna amar rav: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa basis ledavar haasur.
[Hayta ben hechaviyyot kulei.] man tanna dechol hecha deikka issura vehettera — behettera tarchinan, beissura la tarchinan?

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabban shimon ben gamliel hi. ditnan: habborer kitnit beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: borer ochel veochel. uvet hillel omrim: borer kedarko, becheko uvattamchuy.
Vetanya, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim — shehaochel merubbe al happesolet. aval pesolet merubba al haochel — divre hakkol borer ochel.
Veha hacha, dechi ochel merubbe al happesolet dame!
Hacha name, kevan dei bae lemishkal, la mishtekil leh yayin ad deshakel la leeven — kifsolet merubba al haochel dame.

Hayta ben hechaviyyot — magbiah. tanya, rabbi yose omer: hayta hechavit munnachat baotzar, o shehayu kele zechuchit munnachin tachteha — magbiha lemakom acher, umattah al tziddah, vehi nofelet, venotel hemenna ma shetztzarich lo, umachzira limkomah.
Maot sheal hakkar. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa basis ledavar haasur.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella letzorech gufo, aval letzorech mekomo — metaltelo veodan alav. vechen tane chiyyay bar rav middifti: lo shanu ella letzorech gufo, aval letzorech mekomo — metaltelo veodan alav.

Maot sheal hakkar menaer vechulei. amar rabbi oshaya: shachach arnaki bechatzer — manniach aleha kikkar o tinok umetaltelah. amar rav yitzchak: shachach levena bechatzer — manniach aleha kikkar o tinok, umetaltelah. amar rabbi yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi: paam achat shachchu disakkayya melea maot bisratya, uvau veshaalu et rabbi yochanan, veamar lahen: hannichu aleha kikkar o tinok, vetalteluha.
Amar mar zutera: hilcheta kechol hane shematata beshocheach. rav ashe amar: afillu shocheach name [la] — velo amru kikkar o tinok ella lemet bilvad.
Abbaye mannach kappa akkife. rava mannach sakkina abbar yona umetaltelah. amar rav yosef: kamma charifan shematata dedardakke! emar daamur rabbanan beshocheach, lechattechilla mi amur?!
Amar abbaye: i lav deadam chashuv ana, kappa akkife lema li? ha chazu lemizga alayyhu!
Amar rava: ana, i lav deadam chashuv ana — sakkina abbar yona lema li? ha chaze li leumetza.
Tama dachaze leumetza, ha la chaze leumetza — la. lememra derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh?
Vehaamar rava leshammaeh: tevivy li bar avoza, ushedi meeh leshunnara.

a: Hatam kevan demasrach, dateh illaveh meetmol.

Hachi name mistabbera derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, dedaresh rava: ishsha lo tikkanes levet haetzim littol mehen ud. veud shennishbar — asur lehassiko beyom tov, lefi shemmassikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim. shema minna.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: maavirin meal hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin. uvet hillel omrim: mesallek et hattavla kullah umenaarah.
Maavirin millifne hashshulchan perurin pachot mikkezayit, vesear shel afunin usear adashim, mippene shehu maachal behema.
Sefog, im yesh lo or bet achiza — mekannechin bo, veim lav — en mekannechin bo. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach nittal beshabbat, veeno mekabbel tumea.
Gemara amar rav nachman: anu en lanu ella: bet shammay kerabbi yehuda, uvet hillel kerabbi shimon.
Maavirin millifne hashshulchan perurin. mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: perurin sheen bahen kezayit — asur leabbedan bayyad.
Sear shel afunin. manni? — rabbi shimon hi, delet leh muketze.
Ema sefa: sefog, im yesh lo bet achiza — mekannechin bo, veim lav en mekannechin bo. atan lerabbi yehuda, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — asur!
Beha afillu rabbi shimon mode, deabbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut".
Hane garinin detamre arammayayta sheru letaltolinhu, hoil vechazyayn aggav imman. udefarseyayta — asur.
Shemuel metaltel lehu aggav rifta. (590 387 siman.) shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: ose adam kol tzarko befat.
Rabba metaltel lehu aggav lakana demayya. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua aved lehu kigraf shel rei. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: vechi osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla?
Rav sheshet zarek lehu belishshaneh. rav pappa zarek lehu achore hammitta. amru alav al rabbi zecharya ben avkulas shehaya machazir panav achore hammitta vezorkan.
Haderan alach notel adam et beno
b: Mishna chavit shennishbera matztzilin hemenna mezon shalosh seudot, veomer laacherim: bou vehatztzilu lachem. uvilvad shello yispog. en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin, veim yatzu meatzman — asurin. rabbi yehuda omer: im laochalin — hayyotze mehen muttar. veim lemashkin — hayyotze mehen asur. challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat, veyatzu meatzman — asurin, verabbi eliezer mattir.

Gemara tana: lo yispog beyayin velo yetappeach beshemen, shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol. tanu rabbanan: nitpazzeru lo perot bechatzer — melakket al yad al yad, veochel, aval lo letoch hassal velo letoch hakkuppa, shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol.

En sochatin et happerot. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mode haya rabbi yehuda lachachamim bezetim vaanavim. may tama? kevan delischita ninhu — yahev dateh. veulla amar rav: chaluk haya rabbi yehuda af bezetim vaanavim. verabbi yochanan amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda bishar perot, veen halacha kerabbi yehuda bezetim vaanavim.
Amar rabba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mode haya rabbi yehuda lachachamim bezetim vaanavim, umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bishar perot.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi abba: ella bemay peligi? amar leh: lechi tashkach. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera betutim verimmonim peligi.

Detanya: zetim shemmashach mehen shemen vaanavim shemmashach mehen yayin, vehichnisan, ben leochel ben lemashkin — hayyotze mehen asur. tutim shemmashach mehen mayim verimmonim shemmashach mehen yayin, vehichnisan, laochalin — hayyotze mehen muttar, lemashkin velistam — hayyotze mehen asur, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: ben laochalin ben lemashkin — hayyotze mehen asur.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda setam asur?! vehatnan: chalev haishsha metamme leratzon veshello leratzon. chalev behema eno metamme ella leratzon.

Amar rabbi akiva: kal vachomer hu, ume chalev haishsha sheeno meyuchad ella liktannim — metamme leratzon veshello leratzon, chalev habbehema shemyuchad ben liktannim ben ligdolim, eno din sheyyetamme ben leratzon uven shello leratzon? amru lo: im tame chalev haishsha shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tame, yetamme chalev habbehema

a: Shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tahor?! amar lahen: machmir ani bechalav mibbaddam, shehacholev lirfua — tame, vehammakkiz lirfua — tahor. amru lo: salle zetim vaanavim yochichu, shehammashkin hayyotzin mehen leratzon — temein, shello leratzon — tehorim.
May lav "leratzon" — denicha leh, "shello leratzon" — bistama. uma zetim vaanavim divne sechita ninhu, shello leratzon — velo chelum, tutim verimmonim, delav bene sechita ninhu, lo kol shekken?
Lo: "leratzon" — bistama, "shello leratzon" — degalli addateh, deamar: "la nicha li". veibbaet ema: shane salle zetim vaanavim, kevan dilibbud kayymi, meikkara afkore mafkar lehu.
Ashkechan rabbi yehuda demode lerabbanan bezetim uvaanavim. rabbanan demodu leh lerabbi yehuda bishar perot menalan? detanya: sochatin
b: Bifgain uvifrishin uveuzeradin, aval lo berimmonim, veshel bet menashsheya bar menachem hayu sochatin berimmonim.

Umimmay derabbanan hi, dilma rabbi yehuda hi?! veteheve name rabbi yehuda, emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda yatzu meatzman, sochatin lechattechilla mi shamat leh?! ella may it lach lememar: kevan delav bene sechita ninhu — afillu lechattechilla. afillu tema rabbanan, kevan delav bene sechita ninhu — afillu lechattechilla, shema minna rabbanan hi. shema minna.
Shel bet menashsheya bar menachem hayu sochatin berimmonim. amar rav nachman: halacha keshel bet menashsheya bar menachem.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: menashsheya ben menachem tanna hu?! vechi tema halacha ki hay tanna desavar la keshel menashsheya ben menachem, umishshum desavar kimnashsheya ben menachem halacha kemoto? menashsheya ben menachem have rubba dealma?

In, ditnan: hamekayyem kotzim bakkerem, rabbi eliezer omer: kiddesh, vachachamim omrim: eno mekaddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayyeymin. veamar rabbi chanina: may tama derabbi eliezer — shekken baaravya mekayyeymin kotze sadot ligmallehem.
Midde irya? daaravya atra, hacha — batla dato etzel kol adam!

Ella hayeynu tama, kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: teradin shessechatan unetanan bemikve — poslin et hammikve beshinnuy mare. veha lav bene sechita ninhu? ella may it lach lememar — kevan deachshevinhu, havu lehu mashke, hacha name: kevan deachshevinhu, havu lehu mashke.
Rav pappa amar: mishshum dehave davar sheen osin mimmennu mikve lechattechilla, vechol davar sheen osin mimmennu mikve lechattechilla — posel et hammikve beshinnuy mare.

Tenan hatam: nafal letocho yayin o chometz umochal, veshinna marav — pasul. man tanna demochal mashke hu? amar abbaye: rabbi yaakov hi. detanya, rabbi yaakov omer: mochal hare hu kemashke. uma taam amru mochal hayyotze battechilla tahor — lefi sheeno rotze bekiyyumo.
Rabbi shimon omer: mochal eno kemashke. uma taam amru mochal hayyotze meikkul bet habbad tame — lefi shei efshar lo belo tzichtzuche shemen.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deate batar itztzata. rava amar: mishshum dehave davar sheen osin hemennu mikve, ufosel et hammikve beshinnuy mare.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: sochet adam eshkol shel anavim letoch hakkedera, aval lo letoch hakkeara. amar rav chisda: middivre rabbenu nilmad: cholev adam ez letoch hakkedera, aval lo letoch hakkeara. alma kasavar mashke habba leochel — ochel hu.
Metiv rame bar chama: zav shecholev et haez — hechalav tame. vei amrat mashke habba laochalin ochel hu, bemay ittachshar?
Kidamar rabbi yochanan: betippa hameluchelechet al pi haddad, hacha name: betippa hameluchelechet al pi haddad.
Metiv ravina: teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim,

a: Kevetza mechuvvevnet — tahor. ha yoter mikkevetza — tame, vei amrat "mashke habba leochel — ochel hu", bemay ittachshar? hu motev la vehu mefarek la: besochet letoch hakkeara.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: ketannae. hammachalik baanavim — lo hucheshar. rabbi yehuda omer: hucheshar. may lav beha kamippalgi: mar savar mashke habba leochel — ochel hu, umar savar lav ochel hu.

Amar rav pappa: dechulle alma mashke habba leochel lav ochel hu, vehacha bemashke habba leibbud kamippalgi: mar savar mashke hu, umar savar lav mashke hu. uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: hamefatztzea bezetim beyadayim mesoavot — hucheshar. lesoftan bemelach — lo hucheshar.
Leda im higgiu zetav limsok im lav — lo hucheshar. rabbi yehuda omer: hucheshar. may lav beha kamippalgi: demar savar mashke haomed leibbud — mashke hu, umar savar lav mashke hu.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hane tannae bemashke haomed leibbud peligi, vehanach tannae bemashke haomed letzachtzecho kamippalgi.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: sochet adam eshkol shel anavim letoch hakkedera, aval lo letoch hakkeara. vedag letziro afillu letoch hakkeara.

Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: attun mishshemeh derav matnitun vela kashya lechu, anan mishshemeh dishmuel matninan la, vekashya lan: mi amar shemuel dag letziro afillu letoch hakkeara? vehaittemar: kevashim shessechatan, amar rav: legufan — muttar, lememehen — patur, aval asur.
Ushelakot ben legufan ben lememehen — muttar. ushemuel amar: echad kevashim veechad shelakot, legufan — muttar, lememehen — patur, aval asur.

Amar leh: haelohim! "enay rau velo zar (kalu chilyotay becheki vegomer)" — mippummeh derabbi yirmeya shemia li, verabbi yirmeya merabbi zera, verabbi zera merav chiyyay bar ashe, verav chiyyay bar ashe merav.

Gufa. kevashim shessechatan, amar rav: legufan — muttar, lememehen — patur, aval asur. ushelakot, ben legufan ben lememehen — muttar. ushemuel amar: echad ze veechad ze, legufan — muttar, lememehen — patur, aval asur. rabbi yochanan amar: echad kevashim veechad shelakot, legufan — muttar, lememehen — chayyayv chattat.

Metivi: sochatin kevashim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat, aval lo lemotzae shabbat. vezetim vaanavim lo yischot, veim sachat — chayyayv chattat. kashya lerav, kashya lishmuel, kashya lerabbi yochanan. rav metaretz letameh, shemuel metaretz letameh, rabbi yochanan metaretz letameh.

Rav metaretz letameh: sochatin kevashim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat, aval lo lemotzae shabbat. bamme devarim amurim — legufan, aval lememehen patur, aval asur. ushelakot ben legufan ben lememehen — muttar. vezetim vaanavim — lo yischot, veim sechatan — chayyayv chattat.

Shemuel metaretz letameh: sochatin kevashim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat, hu haddin lishlakot. bamme devarim amurim — legufan, aval lememehen — patur, aval asur. vezetim vaanavim lo yischot, veim sachat — chayyayv chattat.

Rabbi yochanan metaretz letameh: sochatin kevashim letzorech hashshabbat aval lo lemotzae shabbat, echad kevashim veechad shelakot. bamme devarim amurim — legufan, aval lememehen — lo yischot, veim sachat — naasa kemi shessachat zetim vaanavim, vechayyayv chattat.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: devar tora — eno chayyayv ella al derisat zetim vaanavim bilvad. vechen tane deve menashshe: devar tora eno chayyayv ella al derisat zetim vaanavim bilvad. veen ed mippi ed kasher
b: Ella leedut ishsha bilvad.
Ibbaya lehu: ed mippi ed leedut bechor, mahu? rav (amme) [ittay] asar, verav assi share.

Amar leh rav amme lerav assi: veha tana deve menashsheya: en ed mippi ed kasher ella leedut ishsha bilvad! ema: leedut shehaishsha keshera lah bilvad. rav yemar achshar ed mippi ed livchor. kare aleh marimar: yemar share buchera. vehilcheta ed mippi ed kasher livchor.
Challot devash. ki ata rav hoshaya minnehardea ata veayyti matnita bideh: zetim vaanavim sherissekan meerev shabbat, veyatzu meatzman — asurin. verabbi elazar verabbi shimon mattirin.

Amar rav yosef: gavra yattira ata leashmoinan. amar leh abbaye: tuva ka mashma lan, dei mimmatnitin hava amena: hatam hu — demeikkara uchela ulevassof uchela, aval hacha demeikkara uchela ulevassof mashke — ema la, ka mashma lan.

Mishna kol shebba bechammin meerev shabbat — shorin oto bechammin beshabbat. vechol shello ba bechammin meerev shabbat — medichin oto bechammin bashshabbat, chutz min hammaliach hayyashan vedagim meluchin ketannim vekolyays haispenin, shehaddachatan zo hi gemar melachtan.
Gemara kegon may? amar rav safra: kegon tarnegolta derabbi abba. veamar rav safra: zimna chada ikkelait lehatam, veochlan minneh, vei la rabbi abba deashkeyayn chamra bar telata tarfe — ittenasi.

Rabbi yochanan rayek mikkutach devavlae. amar rav yosef: velirok anan mittarnegolta derabbi abba. veod, amar rav gazza: zimna chada ikkelait lehatam, vaavadit kutach devavlae, sheilu minneh kol beriche mareva.

Kol shello ba bechammin vechulei. hediach may? amar rav yosef: hediach — chayyayv chattat. amar mar bereh deravina: af anan name tenena: chutz mimmaliach yashan vekolyays haispenin, shehadachatan zo hi gemar melachtan. shema minna.

Yatev rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi kammeh derabbi yochanan, veyatev rabbi yochanan veka menamnem. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi assi: mippene ma ofot shebbevavel shemenim? amar leh: kelach lemidbar azza vearech shemenim mehen. mippene ma moadim shebbevavel semechim? mippene shehen aniyyim. mippene ma talmide chachamim shebbevavel metzuyyaynin? lefi sheenan bene tora. mippene ma goyim mezohamim? mippene sheochlin shekatzim uremasim.

Ittear behu rabbi yochanan, amar lehu: dardeke! lo kach amarti lachem: "emor lachochma achoti at" — im barur lecha haddavar kaachotcha shehi asura lecha — omrehu, veim lav — lo tomrehu. amaru leh: velema lan mar eze mehen? mippene ma ofot shebbevavel shemenim — mippene shello galu, shenneemar: "shaanan moav minneurav veshoket hu el shemarav uvaggola lo halach".

Vehacha menalan diglo? detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chamishshim ushetayim shana lo avar ish bihuda, shenneemar: "al heharim essa vechi vanehi vegomer meof hashshamayim vead behema naddu halachu", "behema" begimatriyya chamshin vetarten havu.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: kullan chazru, chutz mikkolyays haispenin, daamar rav: hane midre devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam. vehay, kevan dela sharir shidreh la matze salek.

Mippene ma moadim shebbevavel semechim? — mippene shello hayu beotah kelala, dichtiv: "vehishbatti kol mesosah chaggah chodshah veshabbattah vechol moadah". uchetiv: "chodshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hayu alay latorach". may "hayu alay latorach"? amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo dayyayn leyisrael shechotin lefanay, ella shemmatrichin oti leda ezo gezera kasha avi alehen! amar rabbi yitzchak: en lecha kol regel varegel shello bata boleshet letzippori. veamar rabbi chanina: en lecha kol regel varegel shello ba litverya agmon vekomton uvaal zemora.

Mippene ma talmide chachamim shebbevavel metzuyyaynin? — lefi sheenan bene mekoman. deamri inashe: bemata shemay, bela mata — totvay. "habbaim yashresh yaakov yatzitz ufarach yisrael". tane rav yosef: ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, sheosin tzitzin uferachim lattora.
Mippene ma goyim mezohamin? — shello amdu al har sinay. shebbeshaa

a: Shebba nachash al chavva hetil bah zuhama, yisrael sheamdu al har sinay — paska zuhamatan, goyim shello amdu al har sinay — lo paska zuhamatan. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: gerim may? amar leh: af al gav deinhu la havo, mazzalayyhu havo. dichtiv: "et asher yeshno po immanu omed hayyom lifne Adonai elohenu veet asher enennu po vegomer".

Ufeliga derabbi abba bar kahana. daamar rabbi abba bar kahana: ad shelosha dorot lo paska zuhama meavotenu: avraham holid et yishmael, yitzchak holid et esav, yaakov holid shenem asar shevatim shello haya bahen shum dofi.

Mishna shover adam et hechavit leechol hemenna gerogrot uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli. veen nokvin megufa shel chavit, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim mattirin, velo yikkevenna mitztziddah. veim hayta nekuva, lo yitten aleha shaava, mippene shehu memareach. amar rabbi yehuda: maase ba lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar: choshshani lo mechattat.
Gemara amar rabbi oshaya: lo shanu ella derusot, aval meforadot — lo. umeforadot lo?
Metivi, rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer: mevi adam et hechavit shel yayin umattiz roshah besayif, umannichah lifne haorchim beshabbat veeno choshesh! hahi rabbanan, matnitin rabbi nechemya hi.

Umay duchekeh derabbi oshaya leokome matnitin kerabbi nechemya uvidrusot, lokma bimforadot verabbanan! amar rava, matnitin keshiteh: may irya detane "gerogrot"? litne "perot"! ella shema minna bidrusot.

Tanya chada: chotalot shel gerogrot veshel temarim — mattir umafkia vechotech. vetanya iddach: mattir aval lo mafkia velo chotech! la kashya, ha — rabbanan, ha — rabbi nechemya. detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: afillu tarvod vaafillu tallit vaafillu sakkin — en nittalin ella letzorech tashmishan.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: mahu lemivraz chavita bevuretya beshabbeta? lefitcha kamikkavven, vaasir, o dilma: leayin yafa kamikkavven, ushere? amar leh: lefitcha ka mechavven, vaasir.
Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mevi adam chavit shel yayin umattiz roshah besayif? hatam — vadday leayin yafa kamikkavven, hacha — im ita dilayin yafa kamikkavven — liftecheh miftach.

En nokvin megufa vechulei. amar rav huna: machaloket lemala, aval min hatztzad — divre hakkol asur. vehayeynu dekatane: "lo yikkevenna mitztziddah". verav chisda amar: machaloket min hatztzad, aval al gabbah — divre hakkol muttar. veha dekatane "lo yikkevenna mitztziddah" — hatam begufah dechavit.

Tanu rabbanan: en nokvin nekev chadash beshabbat, veim ba lehosif — mosif. veyesh omrim: en mosifin. veshavin, shennokvin nekev yashan lechattechilla. vetanna kamma: may shena minnekev chadash dela — deka metakken pitcha, osofe name — ka metakken pitcha!

Amar rabba: devar tora — kol petach sheeno asuy lehachenis ulehotzi — eno petach, verabbanan hu digzur mishshum lul shel tarnegolin, deaved leayyole avvera uleappoke havela. veim ba lehosif — mosif, osofe vadday belul shel tarnegolim — la ate leosofe
b: Mishshum richsha. veyesh omrim en mosifim — zimnin dela takkeneh meikkara, veate learvoche beh. daresh rav nachman mishshum rabbi yochanan halacha keyesh omrim.

Veshavin shennokvin nekev yashan lechattechilla. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bimkom heasuy leshammer, aval lechazzek — asur. hechi dame leshammer, hechi dame lechazzek? amar rav chisda: lemala min hayyayin — zehu leshammer, lematta min hayyayin — zehu lechazzek. rava amar: lematta min hayyayin name zehu leshammer. vehechi dame lechazzek — kegon shennikkeva lematta min hashshemarim.

Amar leh abbaye lerava, tanya dimsayyay lach: bayit satum — yesh lo arba ammot, paratz et patztzimav — en lo arba ammot. bayit satum — eno metamme kol sevivav, paratz et patztzimav — metamme kol sevivav.

Guveta, rav asar ushemuel share. mechattech lechattechilla — dechulle alma la peligi daasir. ahdore — dechulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi dachaticha vela metakkena: man deasar gazrinan dilma ate lemichtach lechattechilla, uman deshare la gazrinan.
Ketannae: en chotchin shefoferet beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. nafla — (en) machazirin otah beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov. verabbi yoshiyya mekel.

Rabbi yoshiyya aheyay? illema aresha — ha kamtakken mana? ella assefa — tanna kamma name mishre kashare? ella dachaticha vela metakkena ikka benayyhu, mar savar: gazrinan. umar savar: la gazrinan. darash rav shisha bereh derav idde mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yoshiyya.

Veim hayta nekuva vechulei. mishcha — rav asar, ushemuel share. man deasar — gazrinan mishshum shaava. uman deshare — la gazrinan. amar leh rav shemuel bar bar chana lerav yosef: beferush amart lan mishshemeh derav — mishcha shere!
Amar tavut rishba amar shemuel: hay tirfa deassa — asur. may tama? rav yemar middifti amar: gezera mishshum marzev. rav ashe amar: gezera shemma yiktom. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu diktim umannach.

Be sadya, rav asar ushemuel share. berakkin — dechulle alma la peligi dishre. bekashin — dechulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi — bemitze: man deasar — michze kemassoy, uman deshare la michze kemassoy.

Veha derav, lav beferush ittemar ella mikkelala ittemar. derav ikkela lehahu atra dela hava leh ravvcha, nefak yetev becharmelit. ayyto leh be sadya, la yetev. man dachaza savar mishshum deve sadya asir, vela hi, derav achroze machriz: be sadya shere, umishshum kevod rabbotenu lo yashav alav. uman ninhu — rav kahana verav assi.

Mishna notnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyyehe shamur, veet hammayim hayyafim baraim, bishvil sheyyitztzanu. veet hatztzonen bachamma bishvil sheyyechammu. mi shennashru kelav badderech bammayim — mehallech bahen veeno choshesh. higgia lechatzer hachitzona — shotchan bachamma, aval lo keneged haam.
Gemara peshita! mahu detema: nigzar mishshum ashvoye gummot, ka mashma lan.
Veet hammayim hayyafim baraim. peshita! sefa itztericha leh. veet hatztzonen bachamma, ha name peshita! mahu detema: nigzor dilma ate leatmone beremetz, ka mashma lan.

Mi shennashru vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: mikkol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin — afillu bechadre chadarim asur. tenan: shotchan bachamma aval lo keneged haam! tannae hi, detanya: shotchan bachamma aval lo keneged haam. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon osrin.
Amar rav huna:

a: Hamenaer tallito beshabbat — chayyayv chattat. vela amaran ella bechadte, aval beattike — let lan ba. vela amaran ella beukkame, aval bechivvare vesummake — let lan ba, vehu dekafed alayyhu.
Ulla ikkela lefumebdita, chaza rabbanan deka menappetzi gelimayyhu, amar: kamchallelin rabbanan shabbeta. amar lehu rav yehuda: nefutzu leh beappeh, anan la kafdinan midde.
Abbaye hava kae kammeh derav yosef. amar leh: hav li kumetay. [chaza deikka] talla aleh, hava kamchassem lemitteve leh. amar leh: nefotz shedi, anan la kafdinan midde.

Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hayyotze betallit mekuppelet munnachat lo al ketefo beshabbat — chayyayv chattat. tanya name hachi: sochare kesut hayyotzim betallitot mekuppalot umunnachot al ketefan bashshabbat — chayyayvin chattat. velo sochare kesut bilvad amru, ella kol adam. ella sheddarkan shel mochrin latzet kach.

Vechenvani hayyotze bemaot hatztzerurin lo bisdino — chayyayv chattat. velo chenvani bilvad amru, ella kol adam. ella sheddarko shel chenvani latzet kach. veharatanin yotzin besudarin sheal ketefan. velo ratanin bilvad amru, ella kol adam. ella sheddarkan shel ratanin latzet bechach.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase behurekanos beno shel rabbi eliezer ben hurekanos sheyyatza besudar sheal ketefo bashshabbat, ella shennima kerucha lo beetzbao, ucheshebba haddavar lifne chachamim, amru: afillu en nima kerucha lo beetzbao. daresh rav nachman bar rav chisda mishshemeh derav chisda: halacha af al pi sheen nima kerucha lo beetzbeotav.
Ulla ikkela leve assi bar hini, beo minneh: mahu laasot marzev beshabbat? amar lehu, hachi amar rabbi ilay: asur laasot marzev beshabbat. may marzev? amar rabbi zera: kise bavlayayta.

Rabbi yirmeya hava yatev kammeh derabbi zera. amar leh: hachi may? amar leh: asur. vehachi may? amar leh: asur. amar rav pappa: nekot hay kelala bidach: kol addata lechannofe — asur, kol dilhitnaot — shere. ki ha derav shisha bereh derav idi mitnae bisdino hava.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: paam achat yatza rabbi lassade vehayu shene tzidde tallito munnachin al ketefo. amar lefanav yehoshua ben zeruz ben chamiv shel rabbi meir: bazo lo chiyyev rabbi meir chattat? amar lo: dikdek rabbi meir ad kan? shilshel rabbi tallito.

Ki ata ravin amar: lo yehoshua ben zeruz hava ella yehoshua ben kefosay haya, chatano shel rabbi akiva, amar: bazo lo chiyyev rabbi akiva chattat? amar lo: dikdek rabbi akiva ad kan? shilshel rabbi tallito. ki ata rav shemuel bar rav yehuda amar: "nishal" ittemar.
Mishna harochetz beme meara uveme teverya venistappeg afillu beeser alontiot — lo yeviem beyado. aval asara bene adam mistappegin baalunetit achat, penehem yedehem veraglehem, umeviin otan beyadan.

Sachin umemashmeshin, aval lo mitammelin. velo mitgarrin. en yordin lekordima, veen osin appiktevizin, veen meatztzevin et hakkatan, veen machazirin et hashshever, mi shennifreka yado veraglo lo yitrefem betzonen, aval rochetz hu kedarko, veim nitrappe — nitrappe.
Gemara katane me meara dumeya deme teverya: ma me teverya chammin — af me meara chammin. "harochetz": diavad — in, lechattechilla — la. mikkelal
b: Dilhishtattef kol gufo afillu lechattechilla shappir dame. manni? rabbi shimon hi. detanya: lo yishtattef adam ben bechammin ben betzonen, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon mattir. rabbi yehuda omer: bechammin — asur, betzonen — muttar.

Venistappeg afillu beeser alunetiyyot. resha revuta ka mashma lan vesefa revuta ka mashma lan. resha revuta ka mashma lan, daafillu hane dela nefishi behu mayya, kevan dechad hu — ate lide sechita, vesefa revuta ka mashma lan, afillu hane dinfishi behu mayya, kevan derabbim ninhu — madkeri ahadade.
Tanu rabbanan: mistappeg adam baalunetit umannichah bachallon. velo yimserenna laolyayrin, mippene shechashudim al oto davar. rabbi shimon omer: mistappeg baalunetit achat umeviah beyado letoch beto.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hilcheta may? amar leh: ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbi, ha shemuel, ha rabbi yochanan.

Rabbi shimon ha daamaran. rabbi — detanya, amar rabbi: keshehayinu lemedin tora etzel rabbi shimon bitkoa, hayinu maalin shemen vaalunetit mechatzer laggag umiggag lekarpef, ad shehayinu maggiin etzel mayan shehayinu rochatzin bo. shemuel — deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mistappeg adam baalunetit umeviah beyado letoch beto. rabbi yochanan — deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha mistappeg adam baalunetit umeviah beyado letoch beto.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: venistappeg afillu beeser alunetiyyot lo yeviem beyado! hahu — keven chachinay matne la.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: haolyayrin meviin ballare nashim leve vane, uvilvad sheyyitkasse bahen roshan verubban. sichnita tzarich lekashsher shene rasheha lematta. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lematta mikketefayim. amar lehu rava livne machoza: ki meabberitu mane livne chela, sharbivu behu lematta mikketefayim.

Sachin umemashmeshin. tanu rabbanan: sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim beshabbat, uvilvad shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol. hechi aved? rabbi chama bar chanina amar: sach veachar kach memashmesh. rabbi yochanan amar: sach umemashmesh bevat achat.

Aval lo mitammelin. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: asur laamod bekarkaitah shel deyomset mippene shemammelet umerappa. amar rabbi yehuda amar rav: kol yameha shel deyomset esrim veechad yom vaatzeret min hamminyan. ibbaya lehu: atzeret battechilla lehay gisa, o lehay gisa? ta shema deamar shemuel: kullehu shakyayne middivcha vead atzarta meallu! dilma hatam hu dechamma dekarir alma mealle, aval hacha mishshum havela hu, kevan dechammim alma tefe mealle.
Amar rabbi chelbo: chamra difrogita umayya didyomset kippechu aseret hashshevatim miyyisrael.

Rabbi elazar ben arach ikkela lehatam, immeshich batrayyhu iakkar talmudeh. ki hadar ata, kam lemikre besifra, bea lemikre "hachodesh hazze lachem", amar "hacheresh haya libbam". beo rabbanan rachame aleh vahadar talmudeh.

Vehayeynu ditnan, rabbi nehoray omer: heve gole limkom tora veal tomar shehi tavo acharecha, shechaverecha yekayyeymuha beyadcha, veel binatcha al tishshaen. tana: lo rabbi nehoray shemo, ella rabbi nechemya shemo. veamri la, rabbi elazar ben arach shemo. velamma nikra shemo rabbi nehoray? — shemmanhir ene chachamim bahalacha.

Aval lo mitgarrin. tanu rabbanan: en gorrin bemigreret bashshabbat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im hayu raglav meluchelachot betit uvetzoa — gorer kedarko veeno choshesh. rav shemuel bar yehuda avada leh immeh magrarta dechaspa.
En yordin lekordima vechulei. may tama? — mishshum pika.
Veen osin appiktevizin beshabbat. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella besam, aval bayyad — muttar. tanya, rabbi nechemya omer: af bachol asur mippene hefsed ochalin.
Veen meatztzevin et hakkatan. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lappofe yanoka beshabbat shappir dame. vehaanan tenan: en meatztzevin! hatam bechumere shidra, demechze kevone.
Veen machazirin et hashshever. amar rabbi chana bagdataa amar shemuel:

a: Halacha: machazirin et hashshever. rabba bar bar chana ikkela lefumebdita, la al lefirkeh derav yehuda. shaddereh laada dayyayla, amar leh: zil garbeh. azal garbeh. ata, ashkecheh deka daresh: en machazirin et hashshever. amar leh: hachi amar rav chana bagdataa amar shemuel: halacha — machazirin et hashshever. amar leh: ha chana didan, veha shemuel didan, vela shemia li — velav bedina geravtaych?!
Mi shennifreka yado kulei. rav avya hava yatev kammeh derav yosef, shanya leh yedeh. amar leh: hachi may? asur. vehachi may? amar leh: asur. addehachi ittefach yedeh.

Amar leh: may tibbee lach, ha tenan: mi shennifreka yado o raglo — lo yitrefem betzonen, aval rochetz kedarko, veim nitrappe — nitrappe. amar leh: vela tenan: "en machazirin et hashshever", veamar rav chana bagdataah amar shemuel: halacha — machazirin et hashshever! amar leh: kullehu bachada mechita mechittinhu?! hecha deittemar — ittemar, hecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.
Haderan alach chavit

Mishna shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen, uvilvad shello yomar lo "haleveni". vechen haishsha mechavertah kikkarot. veim eno maamino — manniach tallito etzlo, veose immo cheshbon leachar shabbat. vechen erev pesach birushalayim shechal lihyot beshabbat, manniach tallito etzlo, venotel et pischo, veose immo cheshbon leachar yom tov.
Gemara amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: may shena hasheileni, umay shena haleveni? amar leh: hasheileni — la ate lemichtav, haleveni — ate lemichtav.

Veha kevan divchol, zimnin devae lememar leh "haleveni" vaamar leh "hasheileni" vela kafed illaveh — veate lemichtav, beshabbat name ate lemichtav! amar leh: (bechol, dela shena ki amar leh "haleveni" la shena ki amar leh "hasheileni", la kafdinan illaveh — ate lemichtav.) beshabbat kevan dehashileni" hu desharu leh rabbanan, "haleveni" la sharu leh — minnachra milleta, vela ate lemichtav.

Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: mikkede amaru rabbanan: kol mille deyom tov kamma deefshar leshannoye meshanninan, hane neshe demalyayn chatzvayyhu mayya, may tama la meshanneyan? mishshum dela efshar: hechi laaved? demalyayn bechatzba rabba, limlo bechatzba zuta — ha ka mappeshu behillucha. demalyayn bechatzba zuta, limlo bechatzba rabba — ka mappeshu bemassoy.
b: Nifros sudara — ate lide sechita. nechasseyeh benichtema — zimnin demippesak, veate lemiktereh. hilkach la efshar.

Vaamar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: tenan lo mesappekin, velo metappechin, velo merakkedin beyom tov. veka chazenan deavdin, vela amrinan lehu vela midde! uletamaych, ha deamar rabba: la littiv inish appumma delechyay, dilma miggandar leh chefetz veate leetoye, veha ka chazenan neshe demayteyayn chatzve veyatvan appumma dimvoa, vela amrinan lehu vela midde! ella: hannach leyisrael, mutav sheyyehu shoggin veal yehu mezidin.

Sevur minna hane mille bidrabbanan, aval bidorayyta — la. vela hi, la shena bidrabbanan vela shena bidorayyta. deha tosefet deyom hakkippurim deorayyta hi, veka chazenan lehu dekaachli veshatu ad shettechshach vela amrinan lehu vela midde.

Vechen ishsha mechavertah kikkarot. beshabbat hu daasir, aval bechol — shappir dame? lema matnitin dela kehillel, ditnan: vechen haya hillel omer: lo talve ishsha kikkar lachavertah ad shettaasenna damim, shemma yukkeru chittin venimtzeu baot lide ribbit!
Afillu tema hillel, ha — beatra dekitz demayhu, ha — beatra dela kitz demayhu.

Veim eno maamino. ittemar halevoat yom tov, rav yosef amar: lo nittena littava, verabba amar: nittena littava. rav yosef amar lo nittena littava: dei amarta nittena littava — ate lemichtav. rabba amar nittena littava: dei amrat lo nittena — la yahev leh veate leimmenoe missimchat yom tov.

Tenan im eno maamino — manniach tallito etzlo: i amrat bishlama lo nittena littava — mishshum hachi manniach tallito etzlo veose immo cheshbon leachar shabbat. ella i amrat nittena littava, ammay manniach tallito etzlo? litten leh velitbeeh! amar: la baena delekum bedina vedayyayna.
Metiv rav idi bar avin: hashshochet et happara vechillekah berosh hashshana. im haya chodesh meubbar — meshammet. veim lav — eno meshammet.
Vei lo nittena littava — may "meshammet"? shane hatam deiggallay milleta dechol hu.
Ta shema missefa: im lav — eno meshammet. i amrat bishlama nittena littava — hayeynu dekatane "eno meshammet". ella i amrat lo nittena littava, ammay eno meshammet? dei yahev leh — shakel.

Mikkelal deresha i yahev leh — la shakel?! resha — tzarich lememar leh "meshammet ani", sefa — la tzarich lememar leh "meshammet ani". keditnan: hammachazir chov bashsheviit, yomar lo: "meshammet ani".
Veim amar lo "af al pi chen" — yekabbel mimmennu, mishshum shenneemar: "veze devar hashshemitta".
Rav avya shakel mashkona. rabba bar ulla miaram iarome.

Vechen erev pesach. amar rabbi yochanan: makdish adam pischo beshabbat, vachagigato beyom tov. nema mesayyay leh: vechen erev pesach birushalayim shechal lihyot beshabbat manniach tallito etzlo, venotel et pischo veose immo cheshbon leachar yom tov.
Hacha bemay askinan — bemamne acherim immo al pischo, demeikkara mikkaddash vekae.
Veha anan tenan: en nimnin al habbehema battechilla beyom tov! shane hacha, kevan deragil etzlo — keman deimmeni beh meikkara dame.

Veha tane rabbi hoshaya: holech adam etzel roe haragil etzlo venoten lo tale lefischo umakdisho veyotze bo! hatam name, kevan deragil etzlo — akdoshe [makdesh] leh meikkara. veha "makdish" katane? hekdesh illuy midderabbanan.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: lo makdishin, velo maarichin, velo macharimin, velo magbihin terumot umaasrot, kol ellu — beyom tov amru, kal vachomer beshabbat! la kashya: kan bechovot shekkavua lahen zeman, kan — bechovot sheen kavua lahen zeman.

Mishna mone adam et orchav veet parperotav mippiv, aval lo min hakketav. mefis adam im banav veim bene veto al hashshulechan, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot mana gedola keneged mana ketanna. umetilin chalashin al hakkodashim beyom tov, aval lo al hammanot.

a: Gemara may tama? rav bivi amar: gezera shemma yimchok. abbaye amar: gezera shemma yikra beshitre hedyotot.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu dichtiv akkotel umiddele: leman deamar shemma yimchok — la chayyshinan, uleman deamar shemma yikra — chayyshinan.

Uleman deamar shemma yimchok, nechush shemma yikra! vetu, leshemma yimchok la chayyshinan? vehatanya: lo yikra leor hanner. veamar rabba: afillu gavoah shete komot, afillu gavoah shete mardeot, afillu asara battim ze al gabbe — ze lo yikra.
Ella, ikka benayyhu dichtiv akkotel umittatte: leman deamar shemma yimchok — chayyshinan, leman deamar shemma yikra — la chayyshinan, gudda bishtara la michallaf.
Uleman deamar shemma yikra, lechush shemma yimchok! ella, ikka benayyhu dachayik attavla veappinkas: leman deamar shemma yimchok — la chayyshinan, leman deamar shemma yikra — chayyshinan.

Uleman deamar shemma yimchok, lechush shemma yikra! vechi tema: tavla ufinkas bishtara la michallaf — vehatanya: mone adam kamma mibbifnim vechamma mibbachutz vechamma manot atid lehanniach lifnehem mikketav sheal gabbe hakkotel, aval lo mikketav sheal gabbe tavla ufinkas!
Hechi dame? illema dichtiv michtav — may shena hacha umay shena hacha. ella lav dachayik, vekatane: mikketav sheal gabbe hakkotel aval lo mikketav sheal gabbe tavla ufinkas!

Ella: leolam dichtiv akkotel umiddele, udeka kashya lach derabba — derabba tannae hi. detanya: mone adam et orchav veet parperotav mippiv, aval lo min hakketav. rabbi acha mattir mikketav sheal gabbe hakkotel.
Hechi dame? illema dichtiv umittattay — lichush shemma yimchok! ella lav dichtiv umiddele, ushema minna derabba tannae hi. shema minna.
Vehane tannae kehane tannae. detanya: en roin bemara beshabbat. rabbi meir mattir bemara hakkevua bakkotel.
May shena hakkevua bakkotel — deaddehachi vehachi middechar, sheeno kavua name: addehachi vehachi middechar!

Hacha bemara shel mattechet askinan, vechidrav nachman amar rabba bar avu. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: mippene ma amru mara shel mattechet asura — mippene sheadam asuy lehashshir bah nimin hameduledalin.

Tanu rabbanan: ketav hamehallech tachat hatztzura vetachat haddeyoknaot — asur likroto beshabbat. udeyokna atzmah — af bachol asur lehistakkel bah, mishshum shenneemar "al tifnu el haelilim". may talmuda? amar rabbi chanin: al tefannu el middatechem.

Mefis adam im banav vechulei. im banav veim bene veto in, veim acher — la. may tama? kidrav yehuda amar shemuel. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bene chavura hammakpidin ze al ze — ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan, umishshum lovin uforin beyom tov,
b: Uchedivre bet hillel af mishshum ribbit.
I hachi banav uvene beto name! banav uvene beto hayeynu tama — kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: muttar lehalevot banav uvene veto beribbit kede lehateiman taam ribbit.
I hachi, mana gedola keneged mana ketanna name!

In hachi name, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: mefis adam im banav veim bene veto al hashshulchan afillu mana gedola keneged mana ketanna. may tama? — kidrav yehuda amar rav. im banav veim bene beto — in, im acherim — la. may tama? kidrav yehuda amar shemuel. mana gedola keneged mana ketanna — af bachol laacherim asur. may tama? — mishshum kuveya.

Metilin chalashin al vechulei. may "aval lo al hammanot"? amar rabbi yaakov bereh devat yaakov: aval lo al hammanot shel chol beyom tov. peshita! mahu detema: hoil uchetiv "veammecha kimrive kohen", afillu manot dechol name. ka mashma lan.

Veamar rabbi yaakov bereh devat yaakov: kol shechavero neenash al yado — en machnisin oto bimchitzato shel hakkadosh baruch hu. menalan? illema mishshum dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai mi yefatte et achav veyaal veyippol beramot gilad vayyomer ze becho veze omer becho. vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vegomer vayyomer etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi kol neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchol tze vaase chen",
Veamrinan: may "ruach", amar rabbi yochanan: ze rucho shel navot. umay "tze" amar rav: tze mimmechitzati. vedilma hatam hayeynu tama, dichtiv "dover shekarim lo yikkon"?!

Ella mehacha: "savata kalon mikkavod shete gam atta vehearel vegomer". "savata kalon mikkavod" — ze nevuchadnetztzar. "shete gam atta vehearel" — ze tzidkiyya. chada, dechulleh kera binvuchadnetztzar ketiv. veod: tzidkiyya tzaddika may hava leh lemibad leh, deamar rabbi yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbikkesh oto rasha laasot leoto tzaddik kach vechulei.
Ella mehacha: "gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov", en "lo tov" ella ra, uchetiv: "ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra" — tzaddik atta Adonai velo yagur bimgurecha ra.

May mashma dehay "chalashim" lishshana defura hu? — dichtiv: "ech nafalta mishshamayim helel ben shachar nigdata laaretz cholesh al goyim vegomer", amar rabba bar rav huna: melammed shehaya metil pur al gedole malchut leda eze ben yomo shel mishkav zachur. uchetiv: "kol malche goyim kullam vegomer", amar rabbi yochanan: shennachu mimmishkav zachur.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: kol yamav shel oto rasha lo nimtza sechok befi kol beriyya, shenneemar: "nacha shakta kol haaretz patzchu rinna", mikkelal dead hasheta la hava rinna.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: asur laamod beveto shel oto rasha, shenneemar: "useirim yerakkedu sham".

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbikkesh oto rasha, laasot leoto tzaddik kach, nimshecha orlato shelosh meot amma, vehayta mechazzeret al kol hammesibba kullah. shenneemar: "savata kalon mikkavod shete gam atta vehearel", arel begimatriyya shelosh meot have.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheyyarad oto rasha legehinnam raashu kol yorde gehinnam, amru: shemma limshol alehem hu ba, o lechalot kemotam hu ba? shenneemar: "gam atta chulleta chamonu elenu nimshalta", yatzta bat kol veamra: "mimmi naamta reda vehoshkeva et arelim".
"Ech shavat noges shavta madheva", amar rabbi yehuda amar rav: shavta umma zo sheamra

a: Medod vehave. veikka deamri, sheamra "meod meod have belo midda".
"Urevu yattira husefat li", amar rav yehuda amar rav yirmeya bar abba: melammed sherachav al ari zachar, vekashar tannin berosho, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vegam et chayyat hassade natatti lo leovdo".

Mishna lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat. velo yomar adam lachavero liskor lo poalim. en machshichin al hattechum liskor lo poalim ulehavi perot, aval machshich hu lishmor, umevi perot beyado. kelal amar abba shaul: kol sheani zakkay baamirato — rashshay ani lehacheshich alav.
Gemara peshita may shena hu umay shena chavero? amar rav pappa: chaver goy. matkef la rav ashe: amira legoy shevut!

Ella amar rav ashe: afillu tema chavero yisrael, ha ka mashma lan: lo yomar adam lachavero "sechor li poalim", aval omer adam lachavero "hanire shettaamod immi laerev?" umatnitin manni — kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha. detanya: lo yomar adam lachavero "hanire shettaamod immi laerev". rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: omer adam lachavero "hanire shettaamod immi laerev".

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi yehoshua ben korcha — dichtiv: "mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar". dibbur — asur, hirhur — muttar.

Rame leh rav acha bar rav huna lerava: mi amar rabbi yochanan dibbur asur hirhur muttar — alma hirhur lav kedibbur dame? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom muttar lehareher, chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse! shane hatam, devaenan "vehaya machanecha kadosh", velekka.
Hacha name, ketiv: "velo yire vecha ervat davar"? hahu, mibbee leh lechidrav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda goy arom — asur likrot keriyyat shema kenegdo.
May irya goy, afillu yisrael name?! "la mibbaya" kaamar: la mibbaya yisrael deasur, aval goy, kevan dichtiv beh: "asher besar chamorim besaram", ema shappir dame, ka mashma lan.
Ema hachi name?! amar kera: "veervat avihem lo rau".

Vedibbur mi asir? veha rav chisda verav hamenuna deamri tarvayyhu: cheshbonot shel mitzva — muttar lechashshevan beshabbat. veamar rabbi elazar: poskim tzedaka laaniyyim beshabbat. veamar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh ufikkuach rabbim beshabbat, veholchin levatte chenesiyyot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat.

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: holchin leteratyaot ulekirkesaot ulevasilkaot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat. vetana deve menashshe: meshaddechin al hattinokot leares beshabbat, veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut?! amar kera: "mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar" — chafatzecha asurim, cheftze shamayim muttarin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: cheshbonot shel [mallach] veshel ma bechach — muttar lechashshevan beshabbat. tanya name hachi: cheshbonot sheavru vesheatidin lihyot — asur lechashshevan. shel mallach
b: Veshel ma bechach — muttar lechashshevan.

Ureminhu: choshvin cheshbonot sheenan tzerichin, veen mechashshevin cheshbonot shetztzerichin, beshabbat. ketzad? omer adam lachavero: "kach vechach poalim hotzeti al sade zo, kach vechach dinarin hotzeti al dira zo". aval lo yomar lo: "kach vechach hotzeti, vechach vechach ani atid lehotzi"!
Uletamaych, kashya lach hi gufa! ella: ha — deikka agra daagira gabbeh. ha — delekka agra daagira gabbeh.

En machshichin. tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad shennifretza lo pirtza betoch sadehu venimlach aleha legodrah, venizkar sheshshabbat hu, venimna oto chasid velo gedarah, venaasa lo nes vealta bo tzalaf, umimmenna hayta parnasato ufarnasat anshe veto.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar laadam lomar lachavero "lichrach peloni ani holech lemachar", sheim yesh bureganin — holech.

Tenan: en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim ulehavi perot. bishlama liskor poalim divshabbat la matze agar, ella lehavi perot? lema: sheim yesh sham mechitztzot — mevi! mashkachat la beferot hamechubbarim.
Vehatane rabbi oshaya: en machshichin al hattechum lehavi teven vakash. bishlama kash mashkachat la bimchubbar. ella teven, hechi mashkachat la? betivna sarya.
Ta shema: machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske challa veal iske hammet. al iske challa vamet — in, al iske acher — la.
Bishlama acher dumeya dechalla mashkachat la lemegaz leh assa. ella met may nihu? — lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. vekatane met — in, aval acher — la.
Veammay? lema: sheim yesh sham mechitztzot — mevi! met name mashkachat la lemegaz leh gelima.

Aval machshichin. veaf al gav dela avdel vehaamar rabbi elazar ben antignos mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: asur lo laadam sheyyaase chafatzav kodem sheyyavdil! vechi tema deavdel bitfilla — vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammavdil battefilla tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos! vechi tema deavdel al hakkos, kos bassade mi ikka?! targema rabbi natan bar amme kammeh derava ben haggittot shanu.

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: bemareva amrinan hachi: "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol" veavdinan tzurekin. amar rav ashe: ki havena be rav kahana hava amar "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol" umesalletinan silte.
Kelal amar abba shaul: kol sheani vechulei. ibbaya lehu: abba shaul aheyay? illema aresha kae: "en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim lehavi perot" —

a: Hay "kol sheani zakkay baamirato rashshay ani bachashichatv"? "kol sheeni zakkay baamirato eni rashshay bachashichato" mibbee leh! ella assefa kae: "aval machshich hu lishmor umevi perot beyado" — hay "kol sheani zakkay bachashichato rashshay ani baamirato" mibbee leh!

Leolam assefa kae, veabba shaul aha kae deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar laadam lomar lachavero "shemor li perot shebbitchumecha, vaani eshmor lecha perot shebbitchumi". vekaamar abba shaul letanna kamma: mi la modet demuttar adam lomar lachavero: "shemor li perot shebbitchumecha vaani eshmor lecha perot shebbitchumi".

Veema: "kol sheani zakkay baamirato — rashshay ani lehacheshich alav". "kelal" leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: en machshichin al hattechum lehavi behema. hayta omedet chutz lattechum — kore lah vehi baa. kelal amar abba shaul: kol sheani zakkay baamirato — rashshay ani lehacheshich alav.

Umachshichin lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. veomrim lo: "lech lemakom peloni, veim lo matzata bemakom peloni — have mimmakom peloni". "lo matzata bemane — have bematayim". rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: uvilvad shello yazkir lo sechum mikkach.

Mishna machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske kalla, veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichim. goy shehevi chalilin beshabbat — lo yispod bahen yisrael, ella im ken bau mimmakom karov. asu lo aron vechafru lo kever — yikkaver bo yisrael. veim bishvil yisrael — lo yikkaver bo olamit.
Gemara may mimmakom karov? rav amar: mimmakom karov mammash. ushemuel amar: chayyshinan shemma chutz lachoma lanu.
Dayka matnitin kevoteh dishmuel, dekatane: "asa lo aron vechafar lo kever — yikkaver bo yisrael". alma missefeka shere, hacha name missefeka shere.

Vetanya kevoteh derav: ir sheyyisrael vegoyim darim bah, vehayta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat, im rov goyim — laerev rochetz bah miyyad. im rov yisrael — yamtin ad kede sheyyechammu chammin. mechetza al mechetza — asur veyamtin ad kede sheyyechammu chammin. rabbi yehuda omer: beambati ketanna, im yesh bah reshut rochetz bah miyyad.

May "reshut"? amar rav yehuda amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: im yesh bah adam chashuv sheyyesh lo asara avadim shemmechammemin lo asara kumekumin bevat achat beambati ketanna — muttar lirchotz bah miyyad.
Asu lo aron vechafru lo kever vechulei. ammay? hacha name yamtin bichde sheyyeasu! amar ulla: beomed beasratya. tinach kever, aron may ikka lememar? amar rabbi avahu: bemutal al kivro.
Mishna osin kol tzorche hammet: sachin umedichin oto, uvilvad shello yaziz bo ever. shomtin et hakkar mittachtav, umetilin oto al hachol bishvil
b: Sheyyamtin. koshrin et hallechi, lo sheyyaale, ella shello yosif. vechen kora shennishbera — somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta, lo shettaale, ella shello tosif.

Gemara vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase betalmido shel rabbi meir shennichnas acharav levet hammerchatz, bikkesh lehadiach karka, amar lo: en medichin. lasuch karka, amar lo: en sachin. karka bekarka — michallefa, met bekarka — la michallaf.
"Kol" leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: meviin keli mekar uchele mattachot, umannichin al kereso kede shello tafuach. ufokkin et nekavav kede shello tikkanes bahen haruach.

Veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "ad shello yeratek chevel hakkesef" — ze chut hashshidra. "vetarutz gullat hazzahav" — ze amma. "vetishshaver kad al hammabbua" — ze hakkares. "venarotz haggalgal el habbor" — ze peresh.

Vechen hu omer: "vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem". amar rav huna veamri la amar rav chagga: ellu bene adam shemmannichin divre tora, veosin kol yemehem kechaggim. amar rabbi levi amar rav pappe amar rabbi yehoshua: leachar shelosha yamim kereso nivkaat venofelet lo al panav, veomeret lo: "tol ma shennatatta bi".
Mishna en meatztzemin et hammet bashshabbat, velo bachol im yetziat nefesh. vehameatztzem im yetziat hannefesh — hare ze shofech damim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hameatztzemo im yetziat hannefesh — hare ze shofech damim. mashal lener shekkava veholechet, adam manniach etzbao aleha — miyyad kavta. tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: harotze sheyyitatztzemu enav shel met — nofeach lo yayin bechotmo, venoten shemen ben rise enav, veochez bishne gudele raglav, vehen mitatztzemin mealehen.

Tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: tinok ben yomo chay — mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, david melech yisrael met — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. tinok ben yomo chay mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, amra tora: challel alav shabbat achat, kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe. david melech yisrael met en mechallelin alav, kevan shemmet adam batel min hammitzvot. vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: "bammetim chofshi" — kevan shemmet adam, naasa chofshi min hammitzvot.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: tinok ben yomo chay — en tzarich leshomro min hachuleda umin haachbarim. aval og melech habbashan met — tzarich leshomro min hachuleda umin haachbarim, shenneemar: "umoraachem vechittechem yihye", kol zeman sheadam chay — emato muttelet al habberiyyot, kevan shemmet — batla emato.

Amar rav pappa, nekitinan: arye abbe tere — la nafel. ha ka chazenan denafel? hahu kidrame bar abba. deamar rame bar abba: en chayya sholetet baadam ad shennidma lo kivhema, shenneemar: "adam bikar bal yalin nimshal kabbehemot nidmu". amar rabbi chanina: asur lishan babbayit yechidi, vechol hayyashen babbayit yechidi — ochazto lilit.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ase ad sheatta motze, umatzuy lecha, veodcha beyadecha. veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "uzechor et borecha bime bechurotecha ad [asher] (she)lo yavou yeme haraa" — ellu yeme hazzikna, "vehiggiu shanim asher tomar en li vahem chefetz" — ellu yeme hammashiach, sheen bahem lo zechut velo chova.
Ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad, shenneemar: ki "lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz".

Tanya, rabbi elazar hakkappar omer: leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim al midda zo, sheim hu lo ba — ba beno, veim beno lo ba — ben beno ba, shenneemar: "ki biglal haddavar hazze". tana deve rabbi yishmael: galgal hu shechozer baolam. amar rav yosef, nekitinan: hay tzureba merabbanan la miane. veha ka chazenan demiane! im ita demiane, ahdore appitcha la mahdar.

Amar la rabbi chiyyay lidvethu: ki ate anya — akdimi leh rifta, ki hechi delakdemu livnayich. amara leh: melat ka layytat lehu?! amar la, kera ka ketiv: "ki biglal haddavar hazze", vetana deve rabbi yishmael — galgal hu shechozer baolam. tanya, rabbi gamliel berabbi omer: "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha", kol hamerachem al habberiyyot — merachamin alav min hashshamayim, vechol sheeno merachem al habberiyyot — en merachamin alav min hashshamayim.

"Ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vehaor" — zo paddachat vehachotem, "vehayyareach" — zo neshama, "vehakkochavim" — ellu hallesatot, "veshavu heavim achar haggashem" — zo meor enav shel adam, sheholech achar habbechi. amar shemuel: hay dimata — ad arbein shenin hadra, mikkan veelach la hadra.

Veamar rav nachman: hay kuchela ad arbein shenin — marvavch, mikkan veelach — afillu mele keachsena degardae — okome mokem, arvoche la marvavch. may ka mashma lan? dechamma deallim mikkuchela — tefe mealle.

Rabbi chanina shechiva leh barteh, la hava ka vache ala. amara leh devethu: tarnegolta appekt mibbetach?! amar la: tarte — techala veivra. savar la ki ha daamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben katztzarta: shesh demaot hen — shalosh yafot, veshalosh raot. shel ashan veshel bechi

a: Veshel bet hakkisse — raot. shel sam veshel sechok veshel perot — yafot.

"Bayyom sheyyazuu shomre habbayit vehitavvetu vegomer". "bayyom sheyyazuu shomre habbayit" — ellu hakkesalim vehatztzelaot. "vehitavvetu anshe hechayil" — ellu shokayim. "uvatlu hattochanot" — ellu shinnayim. "vechashchu haroot baarubbot" — ellu enayim.
Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: may tama la atet leve avidan? amar leh: tur telag sachranohi gelidin. kalvohi la navchin. tachanohi la tachanin. be rav amri: addela abbedna, bacheshna.

Tanya, rabbi yose bar kisma omer: tava tere mittelat. vavy la lachada deazla vela atya. may hi? amar rav chisda: yankuta. ki ata rav dimi amar: yankuta — kelila devavrda, savuta — kelila dechilfa. tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: dok bechakke vetashkach benigre, shenneemar: "vannisba lechem vannihye tovim veraa lo rainu". amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, shere sakkaycha veayyel lachmach. ad arbein shenin — mechla mealle, mikkan veelach — mishteya mealle.
Amar leh hahu gozaa lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha: mehacha lekarchina kamma have? amar leh: kemehacha legozanya. amar leh: barcha karcha bearbea. amar leh: ikra shelifa bitmanya.

Chazyeh dela sayem mesaneh, amar leh: deal sus — melech, deal chamor — ben chorin, udemanale beriglohi — bar inish. dela ha vela ha — dachafir ukevir tav minneh. amar leh: goza goza, telat amart li, telat shamat: haderat panim — zakan, simchat lev — ishsha, "nachalat Adonai — banim". baruch hammakom shemmenaacha mikkullam. amar leh: karcha metzavve?! amar leh: ikra shelifa tochecha!

Amar leh rabbi lerabbi shimon ben chalafta: mippene ma lo hikbalnu panecha baregel, kederech shehikbilu avotay laavotecha? amar leh: selaim naasu gevohim, kerovim naasu rechokim, mishtayim naasu shalosh, mesim shalom babbayit batal.

"Vesuggeru delatayim bashshuk vegomer" — ellu nekavav shel adam. "bishfal kol hattachana" — bishvil kurekvan sheeno tochen. "veyakum lekol hatztzippor" — sheafillu tzippor menaarto mishshenato. "veyishshachu kol benot hashshir" — sheafillu kol sharim vesharot domot alav kesicha.

Veaf barzillay haggiladi amar ledavid: "ben shemonim shana anochi hayyom haeda ben tov lera" — mikkan sheddatan shel zekenim mishtannot. "im yitam avdecha et asher ochal veet asher eshte" — mikkan shessiftotehen shel zekenim mitrappetot. "im eshma od bekol sharim vesharot" — mikkan sheoznehem shel zekenim mitkabbedot.
