Amar rav: barzillay haggiladi shakkara hava. dehahi ammeta dahavay be rabbi bat tishin vetarten shenin, vahavat taama kidra. rava amar: barzillay haggiladi shatuf bezimma hava, vechol hashshatuf bezimma — zikna kofetzet alav. tanya, rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer: talmide chachamim kol zeman shemmazkinin — chachma nittosefet bahem, shenneemar: "bishishim chochma veorech yamim tevuna". veamme haaretz kol zeman shemmazkinin — tippeshut nittosefet bahen, shenneemar: "mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach".

"Gam miggavoah yirau" — sheafillu gavshushit ketanna doma alav kehare harim. "vechatchattim badderech" — beshaa shemmehallech badderech naasu lo tevahim. "veyanetz hashshaked" — zo kelivoset. "veyistabbel hechagav" — ellu agavot. "vetafer haaviyyona" — zo chemda.

Rav kahana hava pasek sidra kammeh derav. ki meta lehay kera, neged veittenach. amar, shema minna betel leh chemdeh derav. amar rav kahana, may dichtiv: "ki hu amar vayyehi" — zo ishsha. "hu tzivva vayyaamod" — ellu banim. tana: ishsha chemet male tzoa, ufiha male dam — vehakkol ratzin achareha.

"Ki holech haadam el bet olamo", amar rabbi yitzchak: melammed shekkol tzaddik vetzaddik notnin lo mador lefi kevodo. mashal lemelech shennichnas hu vaavadav lair, keshehen nichnasin — kullan beshaar echad nichnasin, keshehen lanin — kol echad veechad notnin lo mador lefi kevodo.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "ki hayyaldut vehashshacharut havel" — devarim sheadam ose beyalduto mashchirim panav leet ziknato.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kasha rimma lammet kemachat babbasar hachay, shenneemar: "ach besaro alav yichav". amar rav chisda: nafsho shel adam mitabbelet alav kol shiva, shenneemar: "venafsho alav teeval", uchetiv: "vayyaas leaviv evel shivat yamim".
Amar rav yehuda: met sheen lo menachamin — holchin asara bene adam veyoshvin bimkomo. hahu dishchev beshivavuteh derav yehuda, lo hayu lo menachamin,
b: Kol yoma hava davar rav yehuda be asra, veyatvi beducheteh. leachar shiva yamim itchazi leh bechelmeh derav yehuda, vaamar leh: tanuach datecha shehinnachta et dati.

Amar rabbi avahu: kol sheomrim bifne hammet, yodea, ad sheyyissatem haggolel. peligi ba rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi. chad amar: ad sheyyissatem haggolel, vechad amar: ad sheyyitakkel habbasar.
Man deamar ad sheyyitakkel habbasar, dichtiv: "ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval". man deamar ad sheyyissatem haggolel, dichtiv: "veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: "veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah" — tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha, betohora — af atta betohora. mashal lemelech basar vadam shechalak bigde malchut laavadav. pikchin shebbahen, kippelum vehinnichum bekufesa. tippeshim shebbahen, halchu veasu bahen melacha. leyamim bikkesh hammelech et kelav, pikchin shebbahen hechezirum lo keshehen megohatzin, tippeshin shebbahen hechezirum lo keshehen meluchelachin. sameach hammelech likrat pikchin, vechaas likrat tippeshin.
Al pikchin amar: yinnatnu kelay laotzar, vehem yelchu levattehem leshalom. veal tippeshin amar: kelay yinnatnu lechoves, vehen yechavshu bevet haasurim.

Af hakkadosh baruch hu, al gufan shel tzaddikim omer: "yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam", veal nishmatan hu omer: "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim". al gufan shel reshaim hu omer: "en shalom amar Adonai larshaim", veal nishmatan hu omer: "veet nefesh oyvecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala".

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: nishmatan shel tzaddikim genuzot tachat kisse hakkavod, shenneemar: "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim". veshel reshaim zommot veholchot, [umalach echad omed besof haolam, umalach acher omed besof haolam, umekallein nishmatan ze laze,] shenneemar: "veet nefesh oyvecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala".

Amar leh rabba lerav nachman: shel benonim may? amar leh: ikko shachevna, la amari lechu hay milleta, hachi amar shemuel: ellu vaellu leduma nimsarin. hallalu, yesh lahen manoach. hallalu, en lahen manoach. amar (leh) rav mari: atidi tzaddike dehavu afra, dichtiv: "veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya".

Hanhu kafolae dahavo kafli beara derav nachman. nechar behu rav achay bar yoshiyya. ato vaamaru leh lerav nachman: nechar ban gavra. ata vaamar leh: man nihu mar? amar leh: ana achay bar yoshiyya. amar leh: velav amar rav mari: atidi tzaddike dehavu afra? amar leh: umanni mari dela yadana leh? amar leh: veha kera ketiv: "veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya"!
Amar leh: deakreyaych kohelet, la akreyaych mishle, dichtiv: "urekav atzamot kina". kol mi sheyyesh lo kina belibbo — atzmotav markivim, kol sheen lo kina belibbo — en atzmotav markivim.
Gashshesheh, chazyeh deit beh meshasha. amar leh: lekum mar legavvevy deveta. amar leh: gallet addatach daafillu nevie la keret, dichtiv: "vidatem ki ani Adonai befitchi et kivrotechem".
Amar leh, vehachtiv: "ki afar atta veel afar tashuv"! amar leh: hahu shaa achat kodem techiyyayt hammetim.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu: amritu nishmatan shel tzaddikim genuzot tachat kisse hakkavod. ova tamya, hecha assekeh lishmuel bingida? amar leh: hatam betoch shenem asar chodesh hava, detanya: kol shenem asar chodesh gufo kayyaym, venishmato ola veyoredet. leachar shenem asar chodesh hagguf batel

a: Venishmato ola, veshuv enah yoredet.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: mehespedo shel adam nikkar im ben haolam habba hu, im lav. ini? vehaamar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: achem behespeda, dehatam kaemna! la kashya: ha — dimchammu leh vechaem. ha — dimchammu leh vela chaem.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba: kegon mar desanu leh kullehu pumebditae, man machem hespeda? amar leh: missatay at verabba bar rav chanan.

Bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: ezehu ben haolam habba? amar leh: "veoznecha tishmana davar meacharecha lemor ze hadderech lechu vo ki taaminu vechi tasmeilu". rabbi chanina amar: kol sheddaat rabbotenu nocha hemennu. "vesavvu bashshuk hassofdim", bene galila amri: ase devarim lifne mittatecha, bene yehuda amri: ase devarim leachar mittatecha. vela peligi: mar ki atreh, umar ki atreh.

Tenan hatam, rabbi eliezer omer: shuv yom echad lifne mitatecha. shaalu talmidav et rabbi eliezer: vechi adam yodea ezehu yom yamut? amar lahen: vechol shekken, yashuv hayyom, shemma yamut lemachar, venimtza kol yamav bitshuva. veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim veshemen al roshcha al yechsar".

Amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: mashal lemelech shezzimmen et avadav lisuda, velo kava lahem zeman. pikchin shebbahen kishshetu et atzman veyashvu al petach bet hammelech, amru: kelum chaser levet hammelech? tippeshin shebbahen halchu limlachtan, amru: kelum yesh seuda belo torach?

Pitom bikkesh hammelech et avadav. pikchin shebbahen nichnesu lefanav keshehen mekushshatin, vehattippeshim nichnesu lefanav keshehen meluchelachin. samach hammelech likrat pikchim vechaas likrat tippeshim. amar: hallalu shekkishshetu et atzman lasseuda — yeshvu veyochlu veyishtu, hallalu shello kishshetu atzman lasseuda — yaamdu veyiru.

Chatano shel rabbi meir mishshum rabbi meir amar: af hen nirin kimshammeshin. ella ellu vaellu yoshvin: hallalu — ochlin, vehallalu — reevin. hallalu — shotin, vehallalu — tzemeim, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hinne avaday yochelu veattem tiravu hinne avaday yishtu veattem titzmau hinne avaday yaronnu mittuv lev veattem titzaku mikkeev lev".
Davar acher: "bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim" — ellu tzitzit, "veshemen al roshcha al yechsar" — ellu tefillin.
Haderan alach shoel

Mishna mi shehecheshich badderech — noten kiso legoy, veim en immo goy — mannicho al hachamor. higgia lechatzer hachitzona — notel et hakkelim hannittalin bashshabbat. vesheenan nittalin bashshabbat — mattir hachavalim, vehassakkin noflin (meaylehem).
Gemara may tama sharu leh rabbanan lemittav kiseh legoy? kim lehu lerabbanan deen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, i la sharet leh — ate leetoye arba ammot birshut harabbim.

Amar rava: davka kiso, aval metzia — la. peshita, "kiso" tenan! mahu detema hu haddin afillu metzia, vehay dekatane "kiso" — orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan. vela amaran, ella dela atay lideh, aval atay lideh — kechiseh dame.
Ikka deamri, bae rava: metzia habbaa leyado mahu, kevan daatay lideh — kechiseh dame? o dilma kevan dela tarach ba — lav kechiseh dame. teku.
En immo goy. tama deen immo goy, ha yesh immo goy — legoy yahev leh. may tama? chamor — atta metzuvvev al shevitato, goy — i atta metzuvvev al shevitato.
Chamor vecheresh shote vekatan — achamor mannach leh, lecheresh shote vekatan la yahev leh. may tama? hane — adam, hay — lav adam. cheresh veshote — leshote. shote vekatan — leshote.
Ibbaya lehu: cheresh vekatan may? allibba derabbi eliezer la tibbee lach, detanya: rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: terumat cheresh,
b: Lo tetze lechullin, mippene shehu safek.

Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan, ditnan: chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu en terumatan teruma, ellu hen: cheresh shote vekatan, vehattorem et sheeno shello, vegoy shettaram et shel yisrael afillu birshuto en terumato teruma.
May? lecheresh yahev leh, dekatan ate lichlal daat, o dilma lekatan yahev leh, decheresh ate leichallofe begadol pikkeach. ikka deamri lecheresh yahev leh, ikka deamri lekatan yahev leh.

En sham lo goy velo chamor velo cheresh velo shote velo katan, may? amar rabbi yitzchak: od acheret hayta, velo ratzu chachamim legallotah. may "od acheret hayta"? molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot. ammay lo ratzu chachamim legallotah? — mishshum "kevod elohim haseter davar uchevod melachim chakor davar". vehacha, may "kevod elohim" ikka? dilma ate leetoye arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: bo bayyom gadshu sea. rabbi yehoshua omer: bo bayyom machaku sea.

Tanya: mashal derabbi eliezer, lema haddavar dome — lakkuppa melea kishshuin vedilluin, adam noten letochah chardal — vehi machzeket. mashal derabbi yehoshua, lema haddavar dome — laareva melea devash, noten letochah rimmonim veegozim — vehi mekia.
Amar mar en immo goy mannicho al hachamor. vahalo mechammer, verachamana amar "lo taase chol melacha"!

Amar rav adda bar ahava: mannicho aleha keshehi mehallechet. veha i efshar dela kayyma lehashetin mayim ulehattil gelalim, veikka akira vehannacha! keshehi mehallechet — mannicho aleha, keshehi omedet — notlo hemenna. i hachi, afillu chavero name!
Amar rav pappa: kol shebbegufo chayyayv chattat — bachavero patur aval asur, kol shechavero patur aval asur — bachamoro muttar lechattechilla.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: hayta chavilato munnachat lo al ketefo — ratz tachteha ad shemmaggia leveto. davka ratz, aval kalli kalli — la.
May tama? — kevan delet leh hekkera, ate lemibad akira vehannacha. sof sof, ki mate leveteh i efshar dela kae pureta, vekamayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid! dezarek leh kilachar yad.

Amar rame bar chama: hamechammer acher behemto beshabbat, beshogeg — chayyayv chattat, bemezid — chayyayv sekila. may tama? amar rava: deamar kera: "lo taase chol melacha atta uvehemtecha" — behemto dumeya dideh: ma hu — beshogeg chayyayv chattat, bemezid chayyayv sekila. af behemto name — beshogeg chayyayv chattat, bemezid chayyayv sekila.

Amar rava, shete teshuvot bedavar: chada, dichtiv: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama" — hukkesha kol hattora kullah laavoda zara: ma avoda zara deaved maase begufeh, hacha name ad deaved maase begufeh.
Veod, tenan: hamechallel et hashshabbat bedavar shechayyayvin al shiggato chattat veal zedono sekila. mikkelal deikka midde deen chayyayvin al shiggato chattat velo al zedono sekila,
Umay nihu, "lav" dimchammer? la, techumin veallibba derabbi akiva, vehaveara allibba derabbi yose.

a: Rav zevid matne hachi: amar rame bar chama: hamechammer achar behema beshabbat, beshogeg — eno chayyayv chattat, bemezid — chayyayv sekila.
Metiv rava: hamechallel et hashshabbat bedavar shechayyayvin al shiggato chattat — chayyayvin al zedono sekila. ha en chayyayvin al shiggato chattat — en chayyayvin al zedono sekila!

Mi katane "ha en chayyayvin kulei"? hachi kaamar: davar shechayyayvin al shiggato chattat — chayyayvin al zedono sekila. veyesh davar sheen chayyayvin al shiggato chattat — vechayyayvin al zedono sekila, umay nihu? — mechammer.
Rava achu derav mari bar rachel, veamri la avu derav mari bar rachel. lelishshana batra, kashya ha derav achshereh lerav mari bar rachel umanneyeh befurese devavel. dilma tere mari bar rachel havo.
Hava matni la leha shemata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan liftur. amar rabbi yochanan: hamechammer acher behemto beshabbat patur mikkelum.

Beshogeg la michayyayv chattat — dehukkesha kol hattora kullah laavoda zara. bemezid name la michayyayv — ditnan hamechallel et hashshabbat bedavar shechayyayvin al shiggato chattat veal zedono sekila. ha en chayyayvin al shiggato chattat — en chayyayvin al zedono sekila.
Belav name la michayyayv — dahava leh lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din, vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din en lokin alav.
b: Vaafillu leman deamar lokin, lichtov rachamana "lo taase chol melacha uvehemtecha", "atta" lema li? hu nihu demichayyayv, bivhemto la michayyayv.
Higgia lechatzer hachitzona. amar rav huna: hayta behemto teuna kele zechuchit, mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachteha, umattir hachavalim vehassakkin noflim.
Vehaanan tenan: notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat?
Ki kaamar rav huna, bekarne deummana, dela chazya leh. veha ka mevattel keli mehecheno! bishlife zutere.

Metivi: hayta behemto teuna tevel vaashashiyyot — mattir et hachavalim vehassakkin noflin, veaf al pi shemmishtabberin. hatam bechulesa. dayka name, dekatane dumeya detevel. ma tevel — dela chaze leh, af hacha name la chaze leh.
Umay "af al pi shemmishtabberin" — mahu detema lehefsed muat name chashshu, ka mashma lan.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: hayta behemto teuna shelif shel tevua — manniach rosho tachteha, umesalleko letzad acher, vehu nofel meelav.

Chamoro shel rabban gamliel hayta teuna devash velo ratza leforkah ad motzae shabbat, lemotzae shabbat meta. vehaanan tenan notel kelim hannittalin? keshehidbish. hidbish lemay chaze? lichtita degamle.

Veyattir chavalim veyippelu sakkin! mitzteru zike. veyavi karim uchesatot veyanniach tachtehen! mittannefi, vekamvattel keli mehechano. vehaikka tzaar baale chayyim! kasavar: tzaar baale chayyim derabbanan.

Abbaye ashkecheh leh lerabba deka meshafshef leh livreh aggabba dechamra. amar leh: ka mishtammesh mar bevaale chayyim! amar leh: tzedadin hen, utzedadin la gezaru behu rabbanan. mena temra — ditnan: mattir chavalim vehassakkin noflin. may lav — bechever gevolke, dehavu lehu tzedadin utzedadin, la gezaru behu rabbanan.
La — beever gevolke, dela havo tzedadin. i name, belachta.
Etiveh: shetayim bide adam, veachat beilan — keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. may lav, dechak beh beilan [vesakkech beh] dehavu lehu tzedadin, utzedadin asurin!

La, dechafyeh leilan veannach sikkuch illaveh, dekamishtammesh beilan. i hachi, ema sefa: shalosh bide adam veachat beilan keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. vei dechafyeh leilan — ammay olin lah beyom tov?

Veella may, tzedadin asurin? sof sof ammay olin lah beyom tov? ella: hatam bigvaza parsichna, deilan gufeh dofen bealma hu deshavvevye. dayka name — dekatane: ze hakkelal, kol sheillu yinnatel hailan vichola laamod — olin lah beyom tov. shema minna.
Lema chetannae, en olin lah beyom tov. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: olin lah beyom tov. may lav, beha kamippalgi: demar savar tzedadin asurin, umar savar muttarin?
Amar abbaye: la, dechulle alma tzedadin asurin, vehacha betzidde tzedadin kamippalgi: mar savar tzidde tzedadin asurin, umar savar tzidde tzedadin muttarin.
Rava amar: man deasar bitzdadin — asar name betzidde tzedadin, man deshare betzidde tzedadin — share name bitzdadin. etiveh rav mesharsheya lerava: naatz

a: Yated bailan vetala bah kalkalla. lemala measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv. lematta measara tefachim — eruvo eruv.
Tama denaatz yated bailan, ha lo naatz, afillu lematta measara tefachim en eruvo eruv. veha hay tanna dekaasar bitzdadin, vekashare betzidde tzedadin!
Amar rav pappa: hacha bechalkalla dechuka askinan, devahade deshakel leh leeruv — kamnayyed leh leilan, vekamishtammesh beilan gufeh. vehilcheta: tzedadin asurin, tzidde tzedadin muttarin.

Amar rav ashe: hasheta deamrat tzedadin asurin, hay darga demiddalya — la laynnecheh inish addikla, dehavu lehu tzedadin. ella, laynnecheh aggevoze levar middikla, vechi salek — la laynnach kareh aggevoze, ella littenach akkanin.

Mishna mattirin pekie amir lifne behema, umefaspesin et hakkifin, aval lo et hazzirin. en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hecharuvin lifne behema, ben dakka uven gassa. rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka.

Gemara amar rav huna: hen hen pekiin, hen hen kifin. pekiin tere, kifin telata, zirin — dearze. vehachi kaamar: mattirin pekie amir lifne behema, umefasfesin. vehu haddin lechifin, aval lo et hazzirin — lo lefasfes velo lehattir. amar rav chisda: may tama derav huna ka savar lemitrach beuchela — tarchinan, leshauoye uchela la meshavvenan.

Rav yehuda amar: hen hen pekiin, hen hen zirin. pekiin tere, zirin telata, kifin — dearze. vehachi kaamar: mattirin pekie amir lifne behema, aval paspose — la, vechifin — paspose name mefaspesinan, aval lo hazzirin, lefaspes ella lehattir. amar rava: may tama derav yehuda — kasavar: shauoye uchela — meshavvenan, mitrach beuchela — la tarchinan.

Tenan: en merassekin et hashshachat veet hecharuvin lifne behema, ben dakka uven gassa. may lav, charuvin dumeya deshachat: ma shachat derakkicha, af charuvin derakkiche. alma la tarchinan beuchela — uteyuveteh derav huna!
Amar lecha rav huna: la, shachat dumeya decharuvin: ma charuvin daakoshe, af shachat daakoshe. hechi mashkachat la? beile zutere.

Ta shema: rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka. laddakka — in, legassa — la. i amrat bishlama tanna kamma savar: mitrach beuchela la tarchinan, shauoye meshavvenan, hayeynu deka amar rabbi yehuda charuvin laddakka name shauoye uchela hu. ella i amrat tanna kamma savar shauoye uchela la meshavvenan, mitrach beuchela tarchinan — rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka, kol shekken legassa!
Mi savrat "dakka" — dakka mammash? may "dakka" — gassa, umay kare la "dakka" — dedayyka beuchela.
Ha middekatane resha: "ben dakka uven gassa", mikkelal derabbi yehuda "dakka" — dakka mammash kaamar! kashya.
Ta shema: mechattechin
b: Et haddilluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. may lav, dilluin dumeya dinvela: ma nevela — derakkicha, af dilluin — derakkiche, alma tarchinan beuchela, uteyuveta derav yehuda! amar lach rav yehuda: la, nevela dumeya dedilluin: ma dilluin deashshune, af nevela — deashshuna. vehechi mashkachat la? bivsar pile. i name, begureyayta zutere.
Ta shema, detane rav chanan minnehardea: mefarchin teven veaspasta umearvin. alma tarchinan beuchela! teven betivna sarya, aspasta — beile zutere.

Mishna en ovsin et haggamal velo dorsin, aval malitin. veen maamirin et haagalim, aval malitin. umehalketin lattarnegolin, venotnin mayim lammuresan, aval lo govlin. veen notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach, aval notnin lifne avozin vetarnegolin, velifne yone haredisayot.
Gemara may "en ovsin"? amar rav yehuda: en osin lah evus betoch meeha. mi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, vechidamar rav yirmeya middifti: ledidi chaze li hahu tayyaya deochla kora, veatena kora.

En maamirin. ezo hi hameraa veezo hi haleata? amar rav yehuda: hameraa — limkom sheenah yechola lehachazir, haleata — limkom sheyyechola lehachazir. rav chisda amar: idde veidde limkom sheenah yechola lehachazir, vehameraa bichli, haleata bayyad.

Metiv rav yosef: mehalektin lattarnegolin, veen tzarich lomar shemmalkitin. veen malkitin leyone shovach uleyone aliyyay, veen tzarich lomar sheen mehalektin. may "mehalektin" umay "malkitin"? illema mehalektin — desafe leh bideh, malkitin — deshade leh kammayyhu, mikkelal deyone shovach veyone aliyyay mishde kammayyhu name la?
Ella lav, mehalektin — limkom sheenah yechola lehachazir, malkitin — limkom sheyyechola lehachazir. mikkelal dehamraa bichli, uteyuveta derav yehuda!

Amar lecha rav yehuda: leolam "mehalektin" desafe leh bideh, "malkitin" deshade leh kammayyhu, udeka kashya lach yone shovach veyone aliyyay lemishde kammayyhu name la? hane mezonotan alecha, vehane en mezonotan alecha. kidtanya: notnin mezonot lifne chelev, veen notnin mezonot lifne chazir. uma hefresh ben ze laze? ze mezonotav alecha, veze en mezonotav alecha.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, en notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach, aval notnin lifne avozin velifne tarnegolin velifne yone haredisayot. may tama? lav mishshum dehane mezonotan alecha, vehane en mezonotan alecha.
Velitamaych, may irya mayya? afillu chitte useare name la! ella, shane mayya dishchichi beagma.

Derash rabbi yona appitcha deve nesia: may dichtiv "yodea tzaddik din dallim" — yodea hakkadosh baruch hu bakkelev shemmezonotav muatin, lefichach shoha achilato bemeav shelosha yamim. keditnan: kamma tishhe achilato bemeav vihe tame — bakkelev shelosha yamim meet leet, uvaofot uvaddagim kede shettippol laur vetissaref.

Amar rav hamenuna: shema minna orach ara lemishde umetza lechalba. vechamma? amar rav mari: meshach udeneh, vechutera abbatreh. hane mille bedavra, aval bemata la, deate lemisrach. amar rav pappa: let deani mikkalba, velet deattir mechazira.

Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: ezo hi hameraa, veezo hi haleata? hameraa — marbitzah ufokes et piha umaachilah karshinin umayim bevat achat. haleata — maachilah meummad umashkah meummad, venotnin karshinin bifne atzman umayim bifne atzman.

Mehalektin lattarnegolin kulei. amar abbaye, amrita kammeh demar: matnitin manni? vaamar li: rabbi yose bar yehuda hi. detanya: echad noten et hakkemach veechad noten letocho mayim — haacharon chayyayv, divre rabbi. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: eno chayyayv ad sheyyegabbel.

Dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose bar yehuda hatam ella kemach devar gibbul hu, aval muresan delav bar gibbul hu, afillu rabbi yose bar yehuda mode. la salka data, detanya behedya: en notnin mayim lammuresan, divre rabbi. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: notnin mayim lammuresan.
Tanu rabbanan: en govlin et hakkali. veyesh omrim: govlin. man "yesh omrim"? amar rav chisda:

a: Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi. vehane mille hu dimshanne. hechi meshanne? amar rav chisda: al yad al yad.
Veshavin shebbochashin et hashshattit bashshabbat veshotim zetom hammitzri. vehaamrat "en govlin"! la kashya: ha beava, ha berakka. vehane mille hu dimshanne.

Hechi meshanne? amar rav yosef: bachol noten et hachometz veachar kach noten et hashshattit, bashshabbat noten et hashshattit veachar kach noten et hachometz. levi bereh derav huna bar chiyyay ashkecheh legabbala deve nesheh deka gavel vesafe leh letoreh. betash beh. ata avu ashkecheh, amar leh: hachi amar avu deimmach mishshemeh derav, umannu — rabbi yirmeya bar abba: govlin velo maspin, udela laket belishshaneh — malkitin leh. vehane mille hu dimshanne.
Hechi meshanne? amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye: sheti vaerev. veha la miarav shappir? amar rav yehuda: menaaro lichli.

Ketiv appinkaseh dizeri: amarit kodam rabbi, umannu — rabbi chiyyay: mahu legabbel? amar: asur. mahu lefarek? amar: muttar. amar rav [menashsheya]: chad kamme chad, tere kamme tere — shappir dame. telata kamme tere — asir. rav yosef amar: kav vaafillu kabbayim. ulla amar: kor vaafillu korayim.

Ketiv appinkaseh delevi: amarit kodam rabbi, umannu — rabbenu hakkadosh, al dahavo gavlin shetita bevavel, vahava tzavach rabbi (umannu? — rabbenu hakkadosh, al dahavo gavlin shattita), velet deshama leh, velet chela bideh lemesar midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Ketiv appinkaseh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: hay man divchad beshabba, yehe gevar vela chada beh.

May ["vela chada beh"]? illema: vela chad letevu, vehaamar rav ashe: ana bechad beshabba havay! ella lav chada levishu, vehaamar rav ashe: ana vedimi bar kakozta havenan bechad beshabba, ana melech, vehu hava resh gannave! ella: i kulleh letevu, i kulleh levishu. may tama? deibbero beh or vachoshech.

Hay man devitre beshabba yehe gevar ragzan. may tama? mishshum deippeligu beh mayya. hay man devitlata beshabba — yehe gevar attir vezannay yehe. may tama? mishshum deibbero beh asavim. hay man divarbea beshabba — yehe gevar chakkim venahir. may tama? mishshum deittelo beh meorot.

Hay man divchamsha beshabba — yehe gevar gomel chasadim. may tama? mishshum deibbero beh dagim veofot. hay man divmaale shabbeta — yehe gevar chazran. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chazran bemitzvot. hay man divshabbeta yehe — beshabbeta yemut, al deachilu alohi yoma rabba deshabbeta. amar rava bar rav shela: vekaddisha rabba yitkere.

Amar lehu rabbi chanina, puku emaru leh levar levay: lo mazzal yom gorem ella mazzal shaa gorem. hay man divchamma — yehe gevar zivtan, yehe achel middileh veshate middileh, verazohi galyin, im ganev — la matzlach. hay man divchochav noga — yehe gevar attir vezannay yehe. may tama? mishshum deityelid beh nura. hay man divchochav — yehe gevar nahir vechakkim, mishshum desafra dechamma hu. hay man devilvana — yehe gevar savel marin, bane vesatar, satar uvane, achel dela dileh veshate dela dileh verazohi kasyin im ganev — matzlach. hay man divshabbetay — yehe gevar machshevateh batlin. veit deamri: kol dimchashshevin aleh batlin. hay man divtzedek — yehe gevar tzidkan. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vetzadkan bemitzvot. hay man divmadim — yehe gevar ashed dema. amar rav ashe: i ummana, i gannava, i tabbacha, i mahola. amar rabba: ana bemadim havay. amar abbaye: mar name anesh vekatel.

Ittemar, rabbi chanina omer: mazzal machkim, mazzal maashir, veyesh mazzal leyisrael. rabbi yochanan amar: en mazzal leyisrael. veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: minnayin sheen mazzal leyisrael? shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai el derech haggoyim al tilmadu umeotot hashshamayim al techattu ki yechattu haggoyim mehemma" — hem yechattu, velo yisrael.

Veaf rav savar en mazzal leyisrael, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin sheen mazzal leyisrael? — shenneemar: "vayyotze oto hachutza", amar avraham lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, "ven beti yoresh oti", amar lo: lav — "ki im asher yetze mimmeecha".
Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam nistakkalti beitztagninut shelli, veeni rauy leholid ben. amar lo: tze meitztagninut shellecha, sheen mazzal leyisrael. may dataych?
b: Dekae tzedek bemaarav — mehaddarna umokemna leh bemizrach. vehayeynu dichtiv: "mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo".

Umiddishmuel name en mazzal leyisrael. dishmuel veavlet havo yatvi, vahavo kaazli hanach inashe leagma. amar leh avlet lishmuel: hay gavra azel vela ate, tarek leh chivya umayet. amar leh shemuel: i bar yisrael hu, azel veate. addeyatvi azal vaata.

Kam avlet shadye letuneh, ashkach beh chivya difsik ushede betarte gubbe. amar leh shemuel: may avadt? amar leh: kol yoma hava marminan rifta bahade hadade veachlinan. haiddana hava ikka chad minnan dela hava leh rifta, hava ka mikkesaf. amena lehu: ana kaemna umarmena. ki metay legabbeh, shavvay nafshay keman dishkili minneh, ki hechi dela likkesif. amar leh: mitzva avadt. nefak shemuel uderash: "utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet", velo mimmita meshunna, ella mimmita atzmah.

Umidderabbi akiva name en mazzal leyisrael. derabbi akiva haveya leh beratta, amri leh kaldae: hahu yoma deayyla leve genana, tarek la chivya, umita. hava daeg ammilleta tuva. hahu yoma shekalta lemachbanta, datzta beguda, itremi ittiv beeneh dechivya. letzafra ki ka shakla la, hava ka sarech veate chivya batra.

Amar la avu: may avadt? amara leh befanya ata anya, kera abbava vahavo teridi kulle alma bisudeta, velekka deshameh. kaemna, shekalteh leristanay dihavt li, yahvitteh nihaleh. amar la: mitzva avadt. nefak rabbi akiva uderash: "utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet", velo mimmita meshunna, ella mimmita atzmah.

Umidderav nachman bar yitzchak name en mazzal leyisrael. deimmeh derav nachman bar yitzchak amri la kaldae: berich gannava have. la shevakteh galloye resheh. amara leh: kassi reshaycha, ki hechi detihve alach emta dishmayya, uvei rachame. la hava yada ammay kaamra leh. yoma chad yatev ka gares tute dikla, nefal gelima meillave resheh, deli eneh chaza ledikla, allemeh yitzreh, selek, paskeh lekibbura beshinneh.
Mishna mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat, asura — lefi sheenah min hammuchan.
Gemara ittemar: (arel shachaz siman.) amar ulla: halacha kerabbi yehuda (ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon).

Veaf rav savar halacha kerabbi yehuda. middichrache dezuze, derav asar ushemuel share. veaf levi savar halacha kerabbi yehuda. ki ha delevi ki havo mayyti terefta lekammeh beyoma tava, la hava chaze la ella ki yatev akkiklita. daamar: dilma la mittachshera, vaafillu lichlavim la chazya.

Ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon, veaf zeeri savar halacha kerabbi shimon. ditnan: behema shemmeta — lo yezizenna mimmekomah, vetargema zeeri: bevehemat kodashim. aval bechullin — shappir dame. veaf rabbi yochanan amar halacha kerabbi shimon. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan:

a: En mevakkein etzim min hakkorot, velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov. rabbi yochanan, hahu — kerabbi yose bar yehuda matne la. ta shema: matchilin baaremat hatteven, aval lo baetzim shebbammuketze! hatam bearze veashshuche, demuketze mechamat chesron kis, afillu rabbi shimon mode.
Ta shema: en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot, aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayyaytot!

Rabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach: bet shammay omrim: magbihin meal hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin, uvet hillel omrim: mesallek et hattavla kullah umenaarah. veamar rav nachman, anu en lanu ella bet shammay kerabbi yehuda, uvet hillel kerabbi shimon.

Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: bechol hashshabbat kullah halacha kerabbi shimon, levar mimmuketze mechamat mius, umay nihu? — ner yashan. vechad amar: bemuketze mechamat mius name halacha kerabbi shimon, levar mimmuketze mechamat issur, umay nihu? — ner shehidliku bah beotah shabbat, aval muketze mechamat chesron kis, afillu rabbi shimon mode. ditnan: kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat, chutz mimmassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha.

Mishna mefirin nedarim bashshabbat, venishalin lindarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat. ufokkin et hammaor, umoddin et hammatlet, umoddin et hammikve. umaase bime aviv shel rabbi tzadok uvime abba shaul ben batnit sheppakku et hammaor battafiach, vekashru et hammekidda begemi leda im yesh baggigit poteach tefach im lav, umiddivrehem lamadnu, sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hafara ben letzorech uven shello letzorech, usheela letzorech — in, shello letzorech — la. umishshum hachi kafalginhu mehadade,
O dilma: hafara name letzorech — in, shello letzorech — la, veha deka paleg lehu mehadade mishshum dahafara en tzarich bet din, usheela tzericha bet din?
Ta shema, detane [rav] zute deve rav pappi: mefirin nedarim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat. letzorech hashshabbat in, shello letzorech hashshabbat — la.

Lishshana acharina, ibbaya lehu: "letzorech" attarvayyhu katane, veshello letzorech — la, alma hafarat nedarim meet leet, o dilma ki katane "letzorech" — ashsheela hu dekatane, aval hafarat nedarim afillu shello letzorech, alma hafarat nedarim kol hayyom.
Ta shema, detane rav zute deve rav pappi: mefirin nedarim beshabbat letzorech hashshabbat. letzorech hashshabbat — in, shello letzorech hashshabbat — la, alma hafarat nedarim meet leet.

Amar rav ashe: vehaanan tenan: hafarat nedarim kol hayyom, veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad? nadra lele shabbat — mefer lele shabbat veyom hashshabbat ad shettechshach. nadra im chashecha — mefer ad shello techshach, sheim lo hefer mishshechashecha, eno yachol lehafer. tannae hi, detanya: hafarat nedarim kol hayyom. rabbi yose bar yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru: meet leet.
Venishalim lindarim. ibbaya lehu: keshello haya lo penay, o dilma afillu haya lo penay? ta shema deizdekiku leh rabbanan lerav zutera bereh derav zera ushero leh nidreh, veaf al gav dahava leh penay.
Sheppakku et hammaor battafiach vekashru et hammekidda begemi. amar rav yehuda amar rav: hilkati ketanna hayta ben shene vattim, [vetumea hayta sham]
b: Vegigit seduka munnachat al gabban. ufakku et hammaor battafiach, vekashru et hammekidda begemi leda im yesh sham begigit poteach tefach im lav.

Umiddivrehem lamadnu sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat. ulla ikkela leve resh galuta. chazyeh lerabba bar rav huna deyatev beauona demayya veka mashach leh. amar leh: emar deamri rabbanan medida demitzva, delav mitzva mi amur? amar leh: mitassek bealma ana.
Haderan alach mi shehechshich vaselaykaa la massechet shabbat

a: Mavoy shehu gavoah lemala meesrim amma — yemaet. rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich.
Veharachav meeser ammot yemaet. veim yesh lo tzurat happetach, af al pi shehu rachav meeser ammot en tzarich lemaet.
Gemara tenan hatam: sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma pesula, verabbi yehuda machshir. may shena gabbe sukka detane "pesula" vegabbe mavoy tane takkanta?
Sukka deorayyta, tane "pesula". mavoy derabbanan, tane takkanta.
Veibbaet ema: deorayyta name tane takkanta. ella, sukka dinfishin milleh — pasek vetane "pesula". mavoy dela nefishi milleh — tane takkanta.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: chachamim lo lemaduha ella mippitcho shel hechol, verabbi yehuda lo lemadah ella mippitcho shel ulam.
Ditnan: pitcho shel hechol govho esrim amma verochbo eser ammot, veshel ulam govho arbaim amma verochbo esrim ammot.
Ushenehen mikra echad darshu: "ushechato petach ohel moed", derabbanan savri: kedushshat hechol lechud ukedushshat ulam lechud. vechi ketiv "petach ohel moed" — ahechol ketiv.
Verabbi yehuda savar: hechol veulam kedushsha achat hi. vechi ketiv: "petach ohel moed" — attarvayyhu hu dichtiv.
Veibbaet ema: lerabbi yehuda name kedushshat ulam lechud ukedushshat hechol lechud. vehacha hayeynu tama derabbi yehuda — dichtiv: "el petach ulam habbayit".
Verabbanan: i hava ketiv "el petach ulam" — kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtiv "el petach ulam habbayit" — habbayit happatuach laulam.
Veha ki ketiv hay, bemishkan ketiv!

Ashkechan mishkan deikkeri mikdash, umikdash deikkeri mishkan. dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shelamim sheshshechatan kodem petichat daltot hahechol — pesulin, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed" — bizman sheppetuchin velo bizman shehen neulim, veha ki chetiv hahi, bemishkan ketiv! ella, ashkechan mikdash deikkeri mishkan umishkan deikkeri mikdash.

Bishlama mikdash deikkeri mishkan, dichtiv: "venatatti (et) mishkani betochchem". ella mishkan deikkeri mikdash menalan? illema middichtiv: "venasu hakkehatim nose hammikdash vehekimu et hammishkan ad boam" —
b: Hahu bearon ketiv. ella mehacha: "veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham".

Ben lerabbanan uven lerabbi yehuda lelfu mippetach shaar hechatzer, dichtiv: "orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim vekoma chamesh ammot", uchetiv: "vachamesh esre amma kelaim lakkatef", uchetiv: "velakkatef hashshenit mizze umizze leshaar hechatzer kelaim chamesh esre amma", ma lehallan chamesh berochav esrim, af kan chamesh berochav esrim!
"Petach shaar hechatzer" ikkeri, petach setama — la ikkeri.
Veibbaet ema, ki chetiv: "kelaim chamesh esre amma lakkatef" — beguveha hu dichtiv.
Guveha?! veha ketiv: "vekoma chamesh ammot"! hahu missefat mizbeach ulemala.
Verabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar? veha tenan: veharachav meeser ammot yemaet, vela pelig rabbi yehuda!
Amar abbaye: pelig bevarayyta, detanya: veharachav meeser ammot yemaet, rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich lemaet.
Veliflog bematnitin? pelig beguveha, vehu haddin leruchba.
Veakkatti, rabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar? vehatanya: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma yemaet, verabbi yehuda machshir ad arbaim vachamishshim amma. vetane bar kappara: ad mea.
Bishlama levar kappara guzema. ella lerav yehuda may guzema? bishlama lerabbi yehuda arbaim — gamar mippitcho shel ulam, ella chamishshim mena leh?

Amar rav chisda: ha matnita atiteh lerav, detanya: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma, yoter mippitcho shel hechol — yemaet. hu savar: midderabbanan mippitcho shel hechal gamri, rabbi yehuda mippitcho shel ulam gamar. vela hi, rabbi yehuda mippitcha demalchin gamar.
Verabbanan, i mippitcho shel hechol gemiri — livo delatot kehechol, allema tenan: hechsher mavoy, bet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: lechi o kora!
Daltot hechol litzniut bealma hu daavidan.

Ella meatta, la tayhane leh tzurat happetach, deha hechal tzurat happetach havya lo, afillu hachi eser ammot hu dirvich. allema tenan: im yesh lo tzurat happetach, af al pi sherachav meeser ammot — eno tzarich lemaet!
Midde hu tama ella lerav, ha matne leh rav yehuda lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav: eno tzarich lemaet. vaamar leh: atneyeh "tzarich lemaet".
Ella meatta
